descriptionAr: About the team OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this. In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible. About the role This leadership role will be responsible for driving and implementing the sales strategy within our mid-market segment, recruiting and leading a team of technical sales professionals, and achieving successful deployments with our customers The ideal candidate will possess significant sales leadership experience and a comprehensive understanding of AI technologies. This leader will have the capability to adapt to a complex and fast-changing technology environment. Responsibilities will include customer acquisition, account management, owning executive relationships, and more. This individual will also need to be a proven leader who can effectively collaborate cross-functionally with product, marketing, developer relations, operations, and core GTM teams, while guiding and mentoring a sales team towards achieving business objectives. This role is based in Tokyo . We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you'll: Lead a team of sellers Partner with solutions to build and execute complex customer programs and projects Manage consumption revenue forecasts Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates Support the development of company culture We're seeking someone with experience including: 8+ years leading Enterprise Sales teams Selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service at a product-led growth company Designing and executing complex deal strategies Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.) Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence Reporting on customer success activities You might thrive in this role if you: Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their internal productivity and AI strategy. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor. Have a passion for or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future. Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision. Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions. Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Dubai, UAE About the role The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is a critical sales role responsible for driving high-volume, high-velocity net new business acquisition sales in a remote selling model within the commercial segment across EMEA. Operating as full-cycle territory owners similar to an AE, ISR manages the end-to-end sales process from self-sourcing pipeline, qualifying opportunities and closing deals in partnership with SE and Partner Organisation What you'll do Build your own pipeline: Find new business across your assigned territory through high-volume outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn and social selling, using tools like Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and AI outreach Run the whole sales cycle remotely: Lead discovery and qualification calls using MEDDPIC, give engaging virtual presentations and live product demos, and negotiate and close new business against an ACV quota. Explain the value of Cloudflare's platform: Connect commercial-segment customers' business and technical problems to the right Cloudflare products, such as Application Security and Performance, Zero Trust/SASE and the Developer Platform, and show the value they'd get. Work closely with other teams: Partner with Solutions Engineers on technical validation, and with the Partner Organisation to co-sell and close deals faster. Work with Marketing and BDR teammates on campaigns and events that create pipeline. Run your territory with data: Keep your Salesforce pipeline accurate and your forecasts reliable, track your activity and conversion numbers, and use what you learn to consistently meet or exceed your targets Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience: 1 - 3 years of experience in a sales role, preferably in SaaS or tech sales, such as:  BDR/SDR background with strong outbound experience in a high-paced environment SMB or Transactional sales experience with high volume, high velocity sales motion Strong track record of meeting or exceeding quota  Strong discovery and qualification skills using frameworks like BANT, MEDDIC  Excellent presentation and interpersonal communication skills (verbal and written) as well as time management skill Experience using CRM like Salesforce, outbound/prospecting sales tools (e.g. LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesforce Sales Engagement Outreach etc) Tech-savvy and technically curious - quick to learn technical products, comfortable to run live demos independently, data-driven mindset   Highly accountable and self-driven, customer-centric individuals Multilingual abilities (depending on the coverage regions) What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. descriptionAr: 80% of the world's workforce doesn't sit at a desk. Ordio 💙 is the all-in-one platform that helps these teams run their day: shift planning, time tracking, absence & document management. Simple, fast, and human. We're at an exciting stage of growth: around €5m ARR , with strong foundations in DACH, new products in market, and international expansion underway. Marketing now has the opportunity to become a major growth lever for the business connecting brand, demand generation, product and sales into one commercial engine. We’re looking for a senior, commercially minded marketing leader to build and scale Ordio’s marketing engine for the next stage of growth. You’ll own Marketing end to end, with clear accountability for pipeline, new ARR and efficient growth . You’ll work closely with the CEO, Sales and Product to sharpen our positioning, scale acquisition, improve conversion, and expand a successful GTM motion into new European markets. The opportunity is to build the next version of Ordio’s marketing organisation and grow with the company toward a true CMO level role as Ordio scales toward €20–50m ARR . Tasks Own Ordio’s marketing strategy, budget and operating cadence, with a clear focus on pipeline, customers, ARR, CAC and payback . Build and scale a measurable demand generation engine across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, organic, content and SEO . Go deep into campaign performance, creative, landing pages and conversion — not just manage agencies or dashboards. Own the full funnel from first touch through Closed Won , including lifecycle, CRM, nurture and conversion optimisation. Sharpen Ordio’s positioning and messaging , translating an increasingly broad product suite into simple, differentiated customer value. Raise the bar on brand and creative quality while maintaining strong commercial accountability. Work closely with Sales on shared pipeline and revenue goals. Partner with Product on launches, self-service, trials, PLG experiments and conversion loops. Build the right team, processes, reporting and agency/freelancer setup as the function grows. Help internationalise Ordio’s acquisition engine and establish repeatable GTM playbooks for new European markets. Requirements Significant in house experience in B2B SaaS / software . Experience scaling a SaaS company through a comparable growth stage, ideally somewhere between €3–10m ARR and €15–30m+ ARR . Strong experience with high-volume SMB / Lower Mid-Market acquisition , rather than only enterprise ABM. A proven ability to generate measurable pipeline, customers and revenue through marketing. Strong hands-on knowledge of Google, Meta and LinkedIn , ideally having owned meaningful budgets of €100k+ per month . Strong command of CAC, CPL, conversion, payback, pipeline economics and ARR . A full-funnel mindset: you think from acquisition through Closed Won, not just MQL generation. Strong understanding of brand, positioning, messaging and creative quality alongside performance marketing. Good understanding of content, SEO, lifecycle, CRM and conversion optimisation . Experience working closely with Sales on shared revenue targets and Product on launches, PLG and positioning. Experience leading and developing a marketing team while remaining willing to go deep into campaigns, numbers and execution. A genuine builder mentality: you’ve built or materially improved teams, processes, reporting and acquisition engines. Fluent German and business-fluent English . Benefits 💰 Competitive compensation & benefits 🚀 True ownership of a core growth function with direct impact on pipeline and ARR 🧠 A steep learning curve across growth, product, international expansion and company building 💻 Top-tier equipment (MacBook Pro M4 or higher) 🏡 Flexible setup: Hybrid or fully remote within Germany 💪 Well-being support: Subsidized gym memberships, wellness initiatives, Jobrad 🌎 Guided by our values: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, Earth Is At Ordio 💙, we're looking for people who want to be more than just another employee: ambitious, forward-thinking, and ready to shape the future of work. If you want to build the marketing engine behind Ordio’s next stage of growth, work closely with the CEO, Sales and Product, and have real ownership over how we scale across Europe, we'd love to hear from you.. Ordio is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. Responsibilities Meet or exceed quota while fostering strong customer relationships Articulate the value of GitLab to our Mid Market prospects and customers Take ownership of and act as the CEO for the book of business in your territory: Document the buying criteria & process, next steps & owners Build a strong pipeline through a healthy cadence of prospecting activity Prospect and close new business to expand your territory Ensure adoption of our solutions and do your best to avoid churn and contraction Work and collaborate with our Partner ecosystem to drive new business and value for our customers Create an accurate forecast for each quarter against your plan/budget Drive attendance to our events, which you will be part of to further network with current and prospective customers Contribute to root cause analyses on wins/losses. Communicate lessons learned to the team, including account managers, the marketing team, and the technical team. Contribute to documenting improvements in our sales handbook Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as Customer Success, Renewals, Sales Development, etc. to provide account leadership, ensuring a good outcome for our customers in the pre- and post-sales process Be the voice of the customer by contributing product ideas to our public issue tracker Master MEDPICC and Command of the Message on all opportunities Requirements A true desire to see customers benefit from the investment they make with GitLab Demonstrated progressive experience with Software sales through pitching on value Interest in GitLab, and open source software Ability to leverage established relationships and proven sales techniques for success Effective communicator, strong interpersonal skills Motivated, driven and results oriented Excellent negotiation, presentation and closing skills Preferred experience with Git, Software Development Tools, Application Lifecycle Management You share our values, and work in accordance with those values. descriptionAr: Who We Are Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital. The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page. Role summary Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong. The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers. You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure. What you will own Core security leadership (about half) Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on. Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises. Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline. Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data. Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in. Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders. Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with Legal & Compliance. Own the public security and trust story, including the trust page on our products. Team leadership. Manage and develop our security engineers, decide what we build in-house versus outsource, and grow the team only where automation cannot do the job. Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind scam-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support and Marketing. Legal approves the wording. AI-driven security (about half) Full attack-surface map. Build and maintain a living inventory of everything we run: internal apps, cloud, code repos, and every SaaS tool and integration (CRM, telephony, community, payments, data providers). Know what connects to what, who has access, and what is logged. Agentic security harness. Design and run AI-driven systems that approach 100% coverage: automated code and dependency review, continuous configuration and access audits, and vendor documentation review. Humans set direction and make the judgment calls; agents do the exhaustive work. AI-driven detection and logging. Own the security stack (SIEM, Rapid7; endpoint protection; email security; identity and device management), make sure every critical system sends usable logs, and use AI to triage alerts and hunt across them. Secure AI and vibe-coding standards. Set the rules for how teams build with AI: what can ship, what data AI tools may touch, and the review path before anything with customer data goes live. AI agent security. As more of the company runs on agents and automations, secure them: scoped credentials and tool permissions, prompt-injection defense, data exposure, and monitoring and guardrails for agents in production. Review high-risk agents before launch, including our own security agents. Scope This role protects our company, our platforms, our data and our brands. For members' personal wallets and accounts outside our platforms, our role is education: helping members recognize and avoid scams. Requirements What you will bring Must have 10+ years in security, including 3+ years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or equivalent at a company of 100+ people. Has led live-incident response, not just tabletop exercises, including briefing executives during the incident. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, demonstrating empathy, teamwork and a sense of ownership. Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level. descriptionAr: Perplexity is AI for people who expect more. More accuracy. More agency. More signal, less noise. Our answer engine handles hundreds of millions of queries every month for people whose questions spark change and whose decisions bend the world toward progress. Our legal team works side by side with product and business teams. We help the company move quickly, make sound risk decisions, and build legal requirements into products and operations from the start. About the Opportunity We are looking for a practical, versatile attorney to join our Product, Privacy and Regulatory Legal team. You will have a clear center of gravity in consumer protection and a flexible mandate across product counseling, privacy, regulatory matters, marketing, subscriptions, and international expansion. This is not a narrow subject matter role. You might advise on a new consumer product flow one day, assess an advertising or subscription practice the next, and help respond to a regulator or customer escalation after that. You will work directly with Product, Engineering, Growth, Marketing, Support, Security, GRC, Policy, and Communications. The right person can identify the legal issue quickly, learn the product deeply, and give the business a practical path forward. You will own matters independently and help turn recurring questions into clear guidance and durable systems. This role Reports to the Senior Director, Product, Privacy and Regulatory Legal. What You Will Do Serve as a primary legal partner for consumer products and features from early design through launch and post-launch review Advise on consumer protection issues, including unfair and deceptive practices, disclosures, pricing, subscriptions, renewals, refunds, promotions, advertising claims, dark patterns, and customer support practices Review marketing, growth, and advertising initiatives, including adtech and martech integrations, audience practices, email and messaging campaigns, and product claims Counsel product and engineering teams on privacy, data use, consent, retention, security, AI transparency, age-related protections, and other legal requirements Lead legal review of cross-functional launches and translate complex requirements into practical product and operational choices Support responses to consumer complaints, state attorneys general, competition authorities, privacy authorities, and other regulators around the world, in partnership with the regulatory lead and outside counsel Assess incidents and escalations that cross product, privacy, consumer protection, contractual, and regulatory lines Monitor legal developments affecting AI products and online services, then convert them into clear advice, playbooks, and product requirements Help build scalable legal infrastructure, including templates, review standards, decision records, training, and self-service guidance Flex across the broader Product, Privacy and Regulatory Legal portfolio as company priorities and risk change What We Are Looking For J.D. from an accredited law school, or an LL.M. or equivalent law degree, and current authorization to practice law in the U.S. state where you are located At least five years of relevant legal experience at a law firm, government agency, or in house, with meaningful consumer protection or product counseling experience Strong command of U.S. consumer protection law and enforcement principles, including Section 5 of the FTC Act and state unfair or deceptive acts and practices (UDAP) laws Experience with several of the following areas: subscriptions and auto-renewal, advertising and marketing, privacy and data protection, payments, promotions, platform regulation, or AI governance Ability to lead a product or regulatory matter independently, from fact development through recommendation and execution Excellent judgment. You know what to decide, what to escalate, and how to explain risk without slowing the business unnecessarily Clear, direct writing and the ability to translate legal requirements for product, engineering, and business teams Comfort learning technical systems and asking precise questions about how products, data flows, and controls actually work Hands-on attitude, low ego, intellectual curiosity, and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment Genuine interest in AI products and the legal questions created by how people use them Bonus Experience at the FTC, a state attorney general's office, or another consumer protection or privacy regulator In-house experience at a consumer technology company, online platform, marketplace, or subscription business Experience handling regulator inquiries, investigations, or consumer class action risk Working knowledge of the CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, state privacy laws, ROSCA, CAN-SPAM, TCPA, COPPA, state auto-renewal laws, or similar international consumer regimes

Partner with enterprise customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and success criteria. Make sound technical decisions across model selection, agent and tool design, retrieval, context design, data pipelines, evaluation, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance. Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers to resolution. Partner closely with customers’ engineering teams and OpenAI’s Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and Go-to-Market teams to turn deployment experience into actionable product feedback. Partner with customer security, privacy, clinical and business teams to design responsible AI deployments, including data handling, access controls, evaluation, human oversight and monitoring. Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments. You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have personally designed, built, and shipped AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, taking them from prototype to production and making substantial contributions through coding, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or production engineering. Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working end to end across model APIs, agent and tool development, retrieval and data pipelines, evaluation, observability, integrations, and production operations. Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable. Know how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, automated graders, production signals, and human judgment. Have navigated enterprise production requirements, including integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost. Have experience delivering AI or software in healthcare, life sciences or similarly complex regulated enterprises, with measurable outcomes beyond a proof of concept and familiarity with sensitive data, legacy systems and interoperability. Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. Communicate clearly and credibly with hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security and product teams, and executives. Take end-to-end ownership, exercise strong technical judgment, and move effectively through ambiguity. Healthcare or life sciences experience is strongly preferred; strong candidates from other regulated enterprise environments are also encouraged to apply. Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility. Prior OpenAI product experience is not required. descriptionAr: About the team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence (AGI) benefits all of humanity. Our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization helps customers adopt and scale OpenAI’s products and platform. The GTM Strategy & Planning team sits within Revenue Operations and works at the intersection of GTM Leadership, Strategic Finance, and the broader business. We shape how OpenAI invests, organizes, and scales its revenue organization, translating company ambitions into actionable growth strategies, financial targets, capacity plans, and investment decisions. Our work spans OpenAI’s global GTM organization, including Sales, Technical Success, Partnerships, and emerging businesses. We partner closely with senior leadership to ensure our resources support the highest-impact opportunities as the business grows. About the role We’re looking for a highly analytical and strategic operator to help shape OpenAI’s GTM growth strategy and operating plan. In this role, you’ll tackle some of the most important questions facing our revenue organization: Where should we invest to accelerate growth? How should we allocate resources across markets, segments, and customer motions? What level of productivity can we expect as we scale? How do we translate ambitious financial goals into executable plans? You’ll own planning and analytical workstreams spanning revenue targets, investment strategy, capacity and productivity modeling, and GTM organizational design. Working closely with Strategic Finance, GTM Leadership, and cross-functional partners, you’ll develop rigorous, data-backed recommendations that inform executive decisions. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong financial and analytical skills with strategic judgment, thrives in ambiguity, and can move between detailed modeling and executive-level decision-making. This role is based in San Francisco, CA or New York, NY. In this role, you will: Partner with GTM Leadership and Strategic Finance to translate company financial objectives into growth strategies, resource allocation decisions, and operating plans across regions, segments, and functions. Build headcount, capacity, and productivity models to inform where and how OpenAI invests across Sales, Technical Success, Partnerships, and other GTM functions. Develop regional, segment, and team-level revenue targets, translating company financial goals into executable plans with clear accountability. Build scenario analyses to evaluate how hiring, productivity, product launches, partner distribution, and other growth levers affect revenue performance and investment requirements. Develop data-driven recommendations on segmentation, coverage models, organizational structure, and resource allocation to support growth and operational efficiency. Lead annual and midyear planning cycles, aligning Strategic Finance, GTM Leadership, Field Operations, Data Science, and other stakeholders around a cohesive operating plan. Analyze revenue attainment, capacity, productivity, and other key performance indicators to surface risks, challenge assumptions, and inform strategic decisions. Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership, balancing analytical rigor with business judgment and a company-wide perspective. You might thrive in this role if you: Have 8+ years of experience in GTM Strategy & Operations, Strategic Finance, Business Operations, management consulting, or a similarly analytical and strategic role. Have exceptional analytical and financial modeling skills, with experience building complex models that inform strategic, financial, and operational decisions. Understand GTM strategy, revenue planning, capacity models, and the drivers of growth and productivity in high-growth technology businesses. Have experience with SaaS, consumption-based, or usage-based business models and understand how different GTM motions influence revenue growth. Have led complex, cross-functional initiatives, navigated ambiguity, and aligned senior stakeholders with competing priorities. Bring strong strategic judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and develop practical recommendations. Communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, translating complex analyses into executive narratives that influence leadership decisions. Demonstrate ownership, intellectual curiosity, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment. You may also bring: Experience in AI, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, or other technical product businesses. Experience partnering directly with CRO, CFO, or executive leadership teams on strategic planning and investment decisions. Experience designing GTM coverage models, segmentation strategies, or sales productivity frameworks. Experience managing or mentoring team members. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. descriptionAr: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role Ramp is looking for a Brand Design Recruiter to help build the team behind how our brand shows up in the world. You'll partner with Brand and Creative Studio leaders to define what great looks like for each search, find designers with exceptional visual craft, and guide them through a thoughtful process from first conversation to offer. You'll need to know creative talent, recognize strong work in a portfolio, and build relationships with people before they're actively looking. You'll bring market insight to hiring conversations, keep searches moving at pace, and give candidates a clear, personal experience throughout. What You'll Do Own the hiring engine behind Ramp’s brand, bringing in the full-time designers and freelancers who shape how we show up in the world. Find exceptional creative talent where they share their work, from portfolios and design communities to referrals and events. Turn ambitious creative briefs into focused searches, partnering with Brand and Creative Studio leaders to agree what great looks like. Give candidates a fast, personal experience from first conversation through offer and close. Bring creative leaders, hiring managers, Talent and other partners together around priorities, feedback and decisions so searches keep moving. What You Need 5+ years of recruiting experience, with a strong record of hiring brand or visual design talent. A grasp of creative disciplines from identity and art direction to campaigns, web and motion, and the ability to judge a portfolio beyond the job title. A record of finding and closing designers who were not actively applying, through portfolio research, communities, referrals and tailored outreach. Experience building pipelines for both full-time designers and freelance creative talent, often on different timelines. The ability to keep several searches and stakeholders moving with clear briefs, useful candidate evidence and accurate pipeline data. Nice to Have Experience recruiting for an in-house creative studio, brand team or design agency. Experience building a trusted bench of freelance designers and creative specialists. Experience bringing designers together through events, portfolio reviews or referral programmes. Practical experience using AI tools to research and engage creative talent. Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global) Flexible PTO Centralized home-office equipment ordering Health and wellness stipend Budget for intra-office travel Weekly coffee stipend United States 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents One Medical annual membership 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year) Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay Pet insurance In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed) Canada Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life Life, AD&D, and disability coverage Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime) Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP) Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health United Kingdom Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay Referral Instructions If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf. Other notices Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @ Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. descriptionAr: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! About the role: Cohere is at the forefront of AI innovation, building cutting-edge language models and AI systems. Our Finance team plays a critical role in supporting our rapid growth and ensuring operational excellence. We value technical expertise, collaborative problem-solving, and a commitment to accuracy and compliance. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our financial infrastructure while working at the intersection of finance and transformative technology. As we scale our business and navigate an evolving financial landscape, you'll play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence and serving as a key partner on accounting implications of major business decisions. In this role, you will: Lead the complete month-end close process, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting across all entities Own lease accounting, including accounting assessment under ASC 842, recording and reconciliation of lease-related account transactions, financial reporting, and disclosures Own equity accounting such as stock-based compensation under ASC 718 and IFRS, as well as all other equity-related balance sheet accounts Oversee foreign currency accounting, including functional currency assessment, transaction exposure, and translation adjustments Assist with recording purchase accounting, including purchase price adjustments, acquisition-related expenses, fair value allocations, and related reconciliations Direct general ledger operations, account reconciliations, and financial statement preparation Implement and maintain robust accounting policies, procedures, systems, and internal controls Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure financial accuracy and support business growth Leverage technology solutions to enhance accounting efficiency and accuracy You may be a good fit if you: Have 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, with prior leadership in fast-paced environments Possess strong technical accounting skills and deep understanding of GAAP principles, including lease accounting, equity accounting, business combination, and foreign currency Have direct experience owning month-end close processes using close management tools such as Numeric Demonstrate expertise in purchase accounting, including acquisitions, purchase price adjustments, and related reconciliations Experience with leveraging AI tools to build and improve workflows to achieve operational efficiency and accuracy Demonstrate excellence in problem-solving and process improvement methodologies Show proficiency with financial systems (Netsuite preferred, but not required) Exhibit strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across departments Thrive in high-growth, dynamic environments with evolving priorities Have experience building scalable accounting processes in technology companies Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. How and Where We Work: Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form , and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. An overview of this role The AI Transformation Owner drives the end-to-end AI agenda for the field organization, translating emerging AI capabilities into concrete enablement roadmaps, field use cases, and org-level strategy. You will partner closely with product and engineering teams to pilot and scale AI solutions, own the operational transformation plan needed to embed AI into day-to-day field workflows, and establish the governance framework that keeps AI adoption safe, compliant, and aligned with company standards. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move from strategy to execution without heavy oversight. This role reports to the Vice President, Enablement & AI. What You’ll Do   AI Enablement Roadmap: Own and continuously evolve the roadmap for AI-driven enablement initiatives, prioritizing based on field impact, feasibility, and alignment with broader Enterprise AI team and strategy.. AI Field Use Cases: Identify, scope, and execute on high-value AI use cases for the field (e.g., deal support, prospecting, content generation, guided selling, skills, change management), working with stakeholders to define success criteria and measure impact. AI Field Champions: build relationships with champions in the field organization to activate power-usage and drive peer-led adoption; track this adoption (e.g., usage, proficiency, behavior change) with our AI Ops Specialist and Enablement Analyst. Ops Transformation Plan: Design and drive the operational plan that turns AI pilots into scaled, repeatable processes, coordinating across enablement, ops, and technical teams to remove execution bottlenecks. AI Governance: Influence and lead governance standards for AI tool adoption in the field, including data usage, risk review, tool vetting, and alignment with company-wide AI policy. What You’ll Bring  Mid-Senior Experience: Several years of experience in enablement, sales operations, or a related GTM function, with a track record of owning initiatives end-to-end. AI Solutions Experience: Direct experience evaluating, piloting, or deploying AI tools or solutions in a business context, with a solid technical understanding of how they work and where they add value. Act as the field's primary advocate for AI tools (e.g., AI-assisted prospecting, call intelligence, forecasting copilots, RFP/proposal generation). Cross-Functional Fluency: Proven ability to work closely with product and engineering teams, translating field needs into technical requirements and vice versa. Self-Sufficiency: Comfortable operating with significant autonomy — able to define scope, structure ambiguous problems, and drive work forward without needing detailed direction. Organization & Execution: Strong project management instincts; able to manage multiple workstreams (roadmap, use cases, ops transformation, governance) in parallel without dropping details. Innovative Mindset: A builder's orientation toward new technology — curious about what's possible, willing to experiment, and able to separate genuine opportunity from hype. Enablement/Sales Background: Familiarity with field or sales enablement motions (onboarding, tool adoption, content, coaching) and how AI can realistically augment them. GitLab Values Alignment: Ability to work in an all-remote, asynchronous environment, leaning heavily on transparency and collaboration as defined in the GitLab Handbook. About the team The Enablement & AI function is part of the CRO organization. Enablement is instrumental in helping GitLab grow at a more accelerated pace and achieve our ambitious revenue targets. The enablement organization comprises enablement leads serving the CRO business functions, a centralized content group, AI tech resources, and an operations team. Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule. Strong written communication and remote, asynchronous collaboration skills across distributed, multi-timezone teams. descriptionAr: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? Adoption of AI is moving rapidly from pilots to production. Enterprises are investing in generative-AI programs, creating a once-in-a-decade market inflection point. At Cohere, we’re committed to transforming the enterprise landscape through strategic partnerships and innovative AI solutions. As a Partner Development Manager for the Enterprise Market, you’ll be at the heart of our mission to empower businesses across the region with cutting-edge AI technologies. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic, cross-cultural environment and is passionate about driving growth through collaboration. You’ll work closely with leading enterprises, system integrators, and technology partners to co-create value, expand market reach, and deliver impactful AI solutions tailored to the unique needs of businesses. Your work will directly contribute to our success. You’ll have the opportunity to shape partnerships that drive digital transformation, foster innovation, and position Cohere as a leader in the AI ecosystem. If you’re a strategic thinker, a relationship builder, and eager to make a meaningful impact in one of the world’s most dynamic markets, this role is your chance to shape the future of AI. As our Partner Development Manager you will own the success of our partner relationships. Collaborate with enablement to scale partner enablement through sales and technical workshops, empowering them to deliver value to enterprise customers. Collaborate with partners to identify and pursue high-value opportunities Business Planning & Performance Tracking Ensure partners are aligned with Cohere’s strategic goals and performance metrics. Run joint business planning sessions and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with partners, tracking sourced and influenced ARR against targets. Partner Advocacy & Feedback Serve as the voice of the partner within Cohere, relaying feedback to Product, Engineering, and Legal teams Work with Cohere's Public Policy teams to navigate government AI policies to advise partners on risk management and responsible AI best practices. Thought Leadership & Evangelism Evangelize Cohere’s vision and solutions at partner and industry events, positioning Cohere as a leader in responsible GenAI for the market. Build thought leadership through briefings, speaking engagements, and collaborative initiatives. Why You’ll Love This Role This is a high-impact role where you’ll shape the future of AI partnerships. You’ll work at the intersection of technology, business, and policy, driving growth while ensuring responsible AI adoption. If you’re passionate about building strategic alliances, driving innovation, and making a difference in one of the world’s most dynamic markets, this is the role for you. Deep understanding of the enterprise market and key industry verticals. Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills, with a track record of driving partner success. Ability to navigate complex regulatory and compliance landscapes, including AI ethics and government policies. Working understanding of AI (LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows) Experience working with major system integrators, global consultancies, and hyperscalers including joint GTM and co-sell motions. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Vancouver, BC What you will do as a Customer Engineer The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey. Key Responsibilities Technical Validation: Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals. Customer Adoption & Value Realization: Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk. Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives. Trusted Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes.  AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory. Education & Enablement: Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.   Minimum Qualifications Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience

descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with global pharma and biotech, CROs, and research institutions to deploy existing expertise across the R&D value chain to help customers design and ship production-grade AI systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development, converting early deployments into repeatable system standards and evaluation practices that scale across regulated environments. You will work with customers who are deep experts in their scientific or operational domains, translating real-world data, infrastructure, and constraints into production systems. descriptionAr: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? Cohere seeks an experienced and passionate VP of Services, Customer Success & Support to lead our Customer Success and Support teams. In this role, you will be responsible for leading and developing a talented post-sales Customer Success and Support team, who are the primary owners of business and technical relationships with our customers. The ideal candidate will have a background leading post-sales teams in the ML/AI/Data Engineering industry. In this role you will: Drive product adoption and customer experience for our largest customers. Define the customer lifecycle including roles and responsibilities, handoffs, and workflow & influence the product roadmap. Lead customer-facing teams, including coaching sub-function leaders (Customer Success, Services, Technical Support) to ensure that all teams are aligned and focused on delivering an exceptional customer experience. Measure and analyze customer data to identify trends and areas for improvement, including analyzing customer feedback, support metrics, and other customer-related data to develop insights that can be used to improve the customer experience, troubleshoot issues and showcase Cohere’s value proposition. Enhance the customer journey, identifying the key touch points across interactions with customers and developing strategies to optimize each step of the journey. Champion the customer within the organization, advocating for the customer in all decision-making processes at the executive level to ensure that customer needs are taken into account when making strategic decisions. Collaborate and partner with other internal teams (pre-sales, Product Management, Machine Learning Engineerings) to ensure that the voice of the customer is represented in strategic decisions. You may be a good fit, if you have: 10+ years of leadership experience developing top-performing teams in Customer Success, Technical Support and Services. Work experience in the AI, ML, Data Engineering, Cloud, SaaS or Tech Infra industry. Proven experiences being highly focussed on customer needs, you're an amazing relationship builder and you can proactively spot opportunities to engage customers and build loyalty. An exceptional collaborative mindset and know how to engage and communicate with leadership and technical & non-technical stakeholders. Strong experience building strategy, a willingness to execute and build from the ground up & are always willing to dig deeper and jump in when it comes to our customers. Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. How and Where We Work: Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form , and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations Austin, US Lisbon, Portugal  London, UK  NYC, US  About the Role The Egress team was formed to own a very important aspect of Cloudflare's network-as-a-service: Egress connectivity for our vast portfolio of products. As a member of the Egress team, you will be a key technical contributor to a cutting edge network software infrastructure used by a growing number of Cloudflare products to connect to any destination from Cloudflare's network. Among the products powered by this technology is WARP, our Zero Trust platform, and Cloudflare's egress proxy for the iCloud Private Relay product. You will work closely with various Engineering teams to translate their requirements into new capabilities on the platform. Likewise you will partner with Network Engineering and SRE to ensure that the technology makes the best use of Cloudflare's world-class edge network. You will participate in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from designing and documenting systems, to writing code and automated tests, to planning, managing, and monitoring production software deployments. You will work with a wide range of technologies and programming languages, including Rust, Go, Linux networking, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Grafana, Kubernetes, and more. Engineering teams at Cloudflare operate a Run What You Build model, including ours. We are responsible for the health of our system and participate in our team's on-call rotation as part of operational responsibilities. Because you’ll be solving problems of massive scale and significance, you are a growth-oriented individual who enjoys being outside of your comfort zone. In this role, you could: Build and optimize common web patterns that front-end engineers can use to create features Build tooling that allows engineers to test, debug, and profile front-end features Build desktop infrastructure that is scalable and has deep OS integrations.
