descriptionAr: About the Team The Guardian team builds practical safety and oversight systems for increasingly capable AI agents. Our goal is to make it possible for agents to take on longer-running, higher-autonomy work while preserving meaningful safeguards, respecting user intent, and intervening when actions could cause serious or difficult-to-reverse harm. Auto-review is an early example of this work. When an agent reaches a permission boundary, a separate model evaluates the proposed action in context and determines whether it should proceed. The team is now extending this foundation into more capable oversight systems that account for richer user context, support a broader range of agent experiences, and integrate across OpenAI products. Guardian sits at the intersection of engineering, alignment research, product, infrastructure, and security. The team already has a strong engineering foundation in London and will continue to grow there as a concentrated, highly collaborative group. About the Role We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Guardian team in London. You will design and build production systems that evaluate agent behavior, identify risk, and take appropriate action without creating unnecessary friction for users. This is a hands-on engineering role with substantial technical depth and ownership. You will work across architecture, implementation, evaluation, and operations, taking projects from early exploration through production deployment. The work requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound product judgment, and comfort solving problems where both the requirements and the underlying technology are evolving. You will work closely with alignment researchers to translate emerging research into dependable systems, and with product and engineering teams to make agent safety a foundational capability across OpenAI. This role is based in our London office. In this role, you will: Design, build, and operate core components of Auto-review and the broader Guardian platform, balancing safety, product utility, latency, and operational reliability. Build production systems that evaluate agent actions in real time, detect potentially harmful behavior, and support safe recovery or escalation paths. Improve how oversight systems understand user intent, environmental context, permissions, and relevant personalization signals while protecting privacy and avoiding unnecessary friction. Partner closely with alignment researchers to turn prototypes, evaluations, and new monitoring techniques into scalable product capabilities. Work across Product, Security, Infrastructure, and other engineering teams to integrate Guardian capabilities into agent experiences throughout OpenAI. Develop evaluations, adversarial tests, and monitoring to understand safety performance, false positives, latency, and user impact. Own projects end to end, contribute to technical direction and design reviews, and investigate failures to improve system behavior and reliability. You might thrive in this role if you: Have experience building and shipping complex production software, with ownership across design, implementation, deployment, and operation. Have built with AI agents or large language models in a core product, startup, or technically serious independent project, and understand the unique challenges of agentic systems. Bring strong software engineering fundamentals and can design reliable backend services, APIs, and infrastructure. Exercise sound product-engineering judgment and can navigate tradeoffs across safety, usability, speed, and reliability. Enjoy working closely with researchers, translating open-ended ideas into practical systems, and using experiments and evaluations to guide decisions. Are comfortable with ambiguity, take initiative, and communicate clearly across technical disciplines. Care deeply about building AI systems that are useful, trustworthy, and safe. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity: Grafana Labs seeks a dynamic Manager for our Solutions Architects team, one who shares our enthusiasm for driving successful business outcomes in the observability domain. As a Manager of Solutions Architects, you will help lead a distinguished group of technologists, adept at leveraging Grafana products. You will collaborate directly with our key clients to deploy and enhance Grafana technologies, championing observability best practices. You will also work directly with the Professional Services leadership team to drive continuous improvement and operational rigor. This role will collaborate closely with Sales, Support, Customer Success, and Product teams to build resilient observability solutions aligned with customer and business objectives. This role involves crafting Statements of Work (SOWs), advocating for technological advancements to the Products team, resourcing and managing customer projects, driving operational scale, and managing customer escalations. What You’ll Be Doing: As a member of the Grafana Professional Services team, you will manage a team of Solutions Architects, ensuring members are effectively utilized and driving successful customer outcomes. Ensure team success in designing and building outcomes on the Grafana technology stack. Build educational programs that enhance customer capabilities of the Grafana technology stack. Advise on sales strategies that drive high adoption rates, improved renewal percentages, and ultimately increased revenue. Build lasting customer relationships to enable them to be Grafana advocates and referenceable customers. Balance operational management with direct technical contributions to stay close to the evolving Grafana technology stack. What Makes You a Great Fit: 3+ years of managing a Solutions Architecture team in a related space 5+ years design/implementation/consulting experience with distributed applications 3+ years of experience in infrastructure architecture, database architecture, applications, and networking, or similar technologies. 2+ years of experience in technology/software pre-sales or technical consulting Located in CST Working knowledge of software development tools and methodologies Presentation skills with comfort speaking to customers and executives  Experience building/maintaining observability solutions Excellent communications and writing skills. K8’s Linux experience (2+ years in a company) Shell scripting, API knowledge Observability (monitoring) as a background would be huge High emotional intelligence with a thoughtful approach to client escalations, cross-functional negotiations, and team empathy. Compensation & Rewards In the US, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is $184,000 - $220,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.  Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. descriptionAr: About the team Customer Education helps people and organizations build the skills and confidence to use AI effectively. We create courses, live learning, community programs and product education that help people apply OpenAI’s products to their work. About the role We’re looking for a User Education Lead who is excited about what AI can make possible for people at work and wants to bring more people along on that journey. You’ll lead education for enterprise users who are getting started with AI or need help turning early experimentation into everyday use. You’ll help people discover what’s possible, build confidence through practice and develop the judgment to use AI well. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves both building and teaching. You’ll explore new products, work directly with learners, create practical education and test what helps people make progress. You’ll develop role-based learning and new approaches to teaching AI, then turn what works into frameworks and resources that can reach more people. You’ll work closely with teams across Customer Education, Product and go-to-market to connect this foundational learning to the broader customer experience and help learners progress as their skills grow. In this role, you will: Own the education roadmap for people getting started with AI at work. Identify the skills they need, where they get stuck and the opportunities to help them make meaningful progress. Build and deliver role-based learning. Create courses, live sessions, demonstrations and exercises grounded in the work people actually do, helping learners apply AI to useful tasks in their own roles. Develop and test new approaches to AI education. Experiment with how concepts are explained, how practice is structured and how learners are supported. Turn what works into frameworks and resources that others can adapt and use. Help people build lasting skills and confidence. Design learning that helps people move from a first useful experience to independent, repeat use, with clear paths into more advanced education. Stay close to the product and the learner. Explore new capabilities firsthand, listen to customers and work with Product and customer-facing teams to keep education relevant as their needs change. Measure and improve your work. Assess whether people are developing skills and applying what they learn, then use those insights to improve the learning experience and guide future investment. You might thrive in this role if you: Have built and led education programs that help people develop practical skills and change how they work. Are an engaging teacher and clear writer who can make complex ideas accessible and exciting without oversimplifying them. Are energized by AI’s potential for workers and curious about how to help people who are uncertain, skeptical or just getting started. Use AI actively in your own work, test what you teach and can explain both where it helps and where human judgment matters. Love finding better ways to teach. You listen to learners, try new approaches, learn from the results and share what works. Can set a focused direction, build strong partnerships and deliver high-quality work as products and customer needs evolve. Nice to have: Experience designing learning for different professional roles or functions. Experience creating self-serve education or resources that customers and partners can deliver themselves. descriptionAr: About the Team Industrial Compute develops the infrastructure that powers OpenAI’s AI systems. Our Design organization connects engineering, construction, and digital delivery to support complex data center campuses from initial planning through deployment. Working with internal teams, design consultants, and construction partners, we develop coordinated designs that address site constraints, infrastructure requirements, and future growth. Our BIM team provides the models and workflows needed to deliver consistently across the portfolio. About the Role We are seeking a hands-on Civil BIM Designer & Coordinator with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience to support the planning and design of large-scale, mission-critical data center campuses and associated power generation, energy storage, and utility facilities. In this role, you will develop, coordinate, and maintain civil models using Civil 3D and AutoCAD. Your scope will include site layouts, grading, drainage, roads, and utilities, coordinating buildings with generating equipment, battery energy storage systems (BESS), water treatment plants, gas metering and conditioning facilities, substations, and cooling systems. You will work closely with civil engineers, BIM team, discipline designers, equipment vendors, and delivery partners to turn engineering requirements into clear models and deliverables. Your work will support early design reviews, resolve site coordination challenges, and establish repeatable civil BIM practices across concurrent projects. Detailed engineering requirements and specialist analyses will be provided by the responsible engineers. We are looking for a hands-on civil specialist who can independently manage modeling assignments, communicate design dependencies, and maintain quality as projects evolve. Key Responsibilities Advance feasibility, constructability, and phasing: Prepare layout, grading, routing, and earthwork options for early design reviews; incorporate noise, exhaust dispersion, heat-rejection, safety, and environmental constraints. Model heavy-equipment delivery routes, turning movements, crane areas, laydown, maintenance clearances, staged construction, temporary-to-permanent generation transitions, and future expansion. Lead civil site development: Create and maintain surfaces, grading and earthwork models, equipment and building pads, roads, alignments, profiles, and corridors. Incorporate flood protection, stormwater management, and containment or separation process-drainage requirements. Develop and coordinate plant utility systems: Model gravity and pressure networks for gas supply, cooling and process water, fire water, wastewater, electrical duct banks, and communications. Coordinate utility models, routes, corridors, crossings, connections, and clearances with engineers, consultants, utility providers, vendors, and construction partners. Integrate campus and power-generation infrastructure: Coordinate civil models with buildings, power plants, BESS, substations, water treatment plants, gas metering and conditioning facilities, cooling systems, and other site utilities. Support simple-cycle and combined-cycle gas turbine, reciprocating engine, and CHP layouts while incorporating equipment separation, service access, and fire access. Coordinate equipment, foundation, and thermal interfaces: Integrate vendor general arrangements, foundation footprints, equipment elevations, trenches, pits, and pipe-support locations with inputs from structural, geotechnical, mechanical, and electrical engineers. Coordinate civil interfaces for heat-recovery steam generators, steam-turbine facilities, heat exchangers, cooling towers, air-cooled condensers, radiator arrays, and thermal-distribution corridors. Govern civil model data and multidisciplinary alignment: Manage Civil 3D data shortcuts, external references, coordinate systems, styles, templates, and parts libraries. Coordinate Civil 3D, Revit, vendor, and combined-discipline models; verify coordinates, origins, elevations, units, orientation, and model alignment in Navisworks. Drive coordination and quality: Lead model reviews, investigate clashes and spatial conflicts, communicate design changes, and track issues through resolution. Review civil models and drawings for completeness, reference integrity, consistency, and compliance with project BIM requirements. Deliver and improve civil BIM: Prepare plans, profiles, sections, model exports, review packages, and model-based quantities appropriate to each project phase. Maintain reusable content, document workflows, and improve delivery across data center, power-generation, energy-storage, and utility projects. Qualifications Minimum 8 years of civil design, BIM modeling, or civil infrastructure drafting experience, plus a relevant degree/diploma or equivalent practical experience. Experience supporting mission-critical facilities or complex industrial infrastructure across multiple disciplines. Advanced Civil 3D and AutoCAD proficiency, including grading, corridors, utility networks, sheet production, data shortcuts, references, coordinate systems, and model dependencies. Experience with site-survey data, GIS, point clouds, NavVis or similar laser-scanning/reality-capture workflows. Experience with Navisworks, Revizto, and Autodesk Forma for model coordination, issue tracking, and markups. descriptionAr: ClickHouse has a lot worth saying. The database has become a platform for real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads. Many of the most interesting AI and software companies of the last few years run on it. Our founders and leaders hold clear, well-formed views on where data and AI are heading. And every week the customer base produces proof points most companies would build a campaign around. What we have not yet built is the function whose job it is to turn all of that into one story the market hears consistently, and from us. We are looking for a Head of Story & Communications to build that function from the ground up. You'll own the company narrative: what ClickHouse should be known for, how the platform story gets told above the level of features, and how the proof we generate adds up to a thesis. And you'll build the machine that carries it into the world: the announcement calendar, press and media relationships across technology and business media, and executive platforms for our founders and leaders. This is a build role and a player-coach role. You won't inherit a team; you'll hire one as the function grows, directing our agency partners in the meantime and staying in the work yourself. You'll report to the VP of Global Marketing and work closely with the executive team, product marketing, and the people closest to our customers. What You Will Be Doing Define what ClickHouse should be known for and turn it into a rolling narrative and communications strategy that the marketing and executive teams work from Lead the communications function: set its priorities, operating model, and investment decisions, own its budget, and hold it accountable for results Build the communications machine: announcement calendar and tiering, press materials, holding statements, a reporter cadence, and launch amplification, directing agency partners and holding them to outcomes Own press and media relations across technology and business media, taking the ClickHouse story beyond the tech press and re-educating the market on the full platform Build executive platforms for our founders and leaders: the themes each owns, the moments and formats worth their time, and a clear way to evaluate inbound podcast, mainstage, and sponsored event opportunities Shape quarterly release moments and major launches so they earn attention and show up consistently across press, social, community, and the field Set the standard for how ClickHouse sounds in public: voice, quality bar, and the discipline that every published claim, number, and proof point is approved, current, and consistent Hire and lead the team as the function grows, and build the planning and review rhythm that keeps narrative, communications, and social aligned What You Bring Along Experience building or rebuilding a communications function at a growth-stage infrastructure, developer, or data company Experience hiring, managing, and developing communications team members Experience owning a communications budget and directing agencies to outcomes, with judgment about what belongs in-house A record of landing stories in tier-one business media as well as technology press, with the relationships and news judgment to do it again Experience working directly with a CEO and executive team: shaping their points of view, preparing them, and declining opportunities not worth their time Media-company operator instincts: you think in themes, arcs, and audiences Player-coach approach: you write and edit yourself, give useful feedback, and set the bar by example Comfort with a technical product and a technical audience, including credibility with engineers and developers Experience directing agencies to outcomes, with judgment about what belongs in-house Analytical grounding: you track what is landing, form a view on why, and use it to decide where to focus Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. Equal Opportunity & Privacy ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

descriptionAr: Hello! I'm Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. 👋 One of our biggest priorities is improving the systems and workflows our Support team relies on to do their best work as we grow. That’s why we’re searching for a Support Systems Engineer to become the long-term owner of our Support systems. If you love wrangling operational complexity, building durable systems, and being the person a team relies on to keep everything running well, this is the role for you. About this Role We’re looking for someone who wants to plant a flag in Support Operations, with the experience to independently lead a system implementation and the ambition to keep raising the bar as our Support team grows and the systems and workflows we rely on become more complex. The implementation will build on our existing systems and workflows, alongside our Support Operations Specialist, who helps teams use our tools effectively and keeps operational data reliable. From planning through rollout, you’ll work with IT, RevOps, and Engineering to connect the system to the tools and processes around it. Getting the configuration right is only part of the work. Helping the Support team adopt new workflows matters just as much. The configuration, automations, and integrations behind our Support systems will remain yours to own and improve as our needs evolve. You’ll be the person we rely on when something breaks, doesn’t scale, or needs to be rethought entirely. Role Responsibilities Lead System Implementations Own implementation of new systems, tools, and workflows from planning and pilot through full rollout, including configuration, data migration, and integrations with our existing tools. Design routing logic, SLAs, escalation paths, and reporting that can handle more complexity as we grow. Develop and lead a change management plan that helps the team adopt new systems and workflows, with clear communication, thoughtful training, and structured feedback from frontline teams and Support leaders. Administer and Optimize Support Systems Serve as the long-term administrator for our Support systems, owning configuration, automations, workflow improvements, and governance, with access management handled in partnership with internal IT. Keep finding ways to reduce friction for the team and our customers. Document system architecture, admin processes, and escalation paths, and keep that documentation current. Evaluate new tools and integrations as our needs evolve, using structured demos and input from the teams affected. Pressure-test vendor promises against our requirements, recommend solutions, and hold vendors to their commitments after the contract is signed. Partner Across Support Partner with Workforce Management, QA, and Support Training to make sure our systems support capacity planning, reporting, and the technical workflows each team relies on. Be the go-to person for Support tooling, advising on configuration decisions and working with Support Leadership to prioritize the systems improvements that matter most to the team. Role Requirements Hands-on experience implementing or administering a support ticketing system such as Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Intercom, Plain, Pylon, or a comparable platform. You’ve configured the system yourself, not just managed the project. Experience owning a support-system migration or implementation, from scoping through go-live and beyond. You can make judgment calls when requirements are unclear and see projects through without losing momentum. Vendor evaluation experience with real skepticism. You know how to build an assessment framework, pressure-test a demo, and hold vendors to commitments after the contract is signed. You understand Support workflows, including routing, SLA and priority configuration, queue management, escalation paths, and the reporting Support leaders rely on. You understand integrations, APIs, and data migration well enough to work through technical requirements with engineers. You don’t need to write the code, but you need to understand what you’re asking for and why it matters. You can spot workflow friction, anticipate what will break as we grow, and make thoughtful tradeoffs about what to fix now versus later. Experience guiding teams through system or workflow changes, with clear communication, thoughtful training, and structured feedback from frontline teams and senior stakeholders. You know that a successful rollout depends on how people use the system, not just whether it works. You can build strong working relationships with Workforce Management, QA, Engineering, and Support Leadership. You’re comfortable explaining technical decisions to frontline team members and making the business case to senior stakeholders. You Should Apply If: You’ve worked directly inside a support ticketing system and personally owned a system migration or implementation. You know where these projects go sideways and how to keep them on track. You want to own what you build, including ongoing administration, documentation, and improvement. Getting a system running reliably is satisfying, but so is finding ways to make it better as the team grows and our customers’ needs evolve. You’ve questioned vendor promises and know how to get past a polished demo to understand what a product can actually deliver. You move comfortably between the bigger picture and the details. You can present a vendor recommendation to leadership in the morning and dig into workflow configuration in the afternoon. You like being the person a team turns to when something breaks or doesn’t feel right. When you spot unnecessary friction, you take ownership of fixing it rather than waiting to be asked. You Should Not Apply If: You haven’t worked directly inside a support ticketing system at an admin or implementation level, or you want to manage this work from a distance. descriptionAr: About the Role OpenAI’s largest and most strategic customers are turning AI ambition into deployments that change how their organizations work. As a Delivery Lead, you will own delivery of priority AI initiatives for these customers, leading complex, high-impact deployments from planning through launch and adoption. You’ll establish an integrated delivery plan, drive execution against launch commitments, resolve blockers, and lead progress toward measurable customer value. You’ll partner closely with account and technical teams, FDEs, customers, and delivery partners to turn customer priorities into successful deployments. You’ll bring a clear view of delivery progress, risks, and expected outcomes, helping teams make informed decisions and connecting successful execution to consumption and growth. This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can move between executive conversations and practical details that determine whether a deployment succeeds. You bring technical fluency, sound judgment, and the ability to create clarity and drive action in complex, evolving environments. What You’ll Do Own delivery of priority AI initiatives. Lead complex customer engagements from scoping and planning through deployment, launch, and initial adoption. Build and drive an integrated delivery plan. Establish clear scope, milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, resource needs, and success measures across customer, OpenAI, and partner teams. Resolve blockers and drive decisions. Identify risks early, work through dependencies and resource constraints, and bring the right stakeholders together to resolve tradeoffs and keep delivery moving. Lead launch readiness and activation. Drive rollout and enablement planning, address technical and organizational readiness gaps, and remove barriers to initial adoption and usage. Connect delivery to customer value. Define expected outcomes and measurement approaches with customers and account teams. Track adoption and consumption, assess results against agreed baselines, and communicate the value achieved. Provide a clear view of delivery health. Lead customer and internal delivery reviews that drive decisions and action. Communicate progress, launch confidence, risks, and implications for expected consumption and revenue timing. Improve how we deliver. Turn customer experience into repeatable playbooks, practical tools, and actionable feedback for product and delivery teams. What We’re Looking For 7+ years of experience leading complex enterprise technology deployments, customer delivery programs, or transformation initiatives involving multiple teams and partners. A track record of driving programs from scope through launch and adoption, with accountability for delivery commitments and measurable customer outcomes. Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand AI systems, APIs, integrations, enterprise architecture, security dependencies, and deployment risks. The ability to translate customer priorities into actionable delivery plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and success measures. Strong judgment under ambiguity, including the ability to identify material risks, navigate competing priorities, and drive timely decisions. Experience building trust with customers and leading across teams outside your reporting line while holding stakeholders accountable to shared commitments. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage executives, technical specialists, and customer operators and explain complex delivery issues clearly. Commercial awareness and an understanding of how deployment, adoption, and consumption contribute to customer value and growth. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA or London, UK (Hybrid) About the Role You’ll help define how machine learning models run across Cloudflare’s global network, from frontier open LLMs and real-time voice models to customer-deployed models served on heterogeneous GPUs and next-generation accelerators. You’ll work with systems engineers, product teams, hardware partners, and AI/ML engineers to bring models into production with low latency, strong reliability, and efficient resource use. This role combines applied ML, inference optimization, evaluation, and production engineering, with a focus on benchmarking models, improving serving performance, validating quality, and building tooling that helps Cloudflare and its customers ship AI applications at Internet scale. Responsibilities Develop, optimize, and productionize machine learning models for Cloudflare’s serverless inference platform, with a focus on performance, reliability, and model quality. Build benchmarking and evaluation frameworks to measure latency, throughput, cost efficiency, and model behavior across LLMs, speech, vision, and other model families. Improve inference performance through quantization, batching, caching, model compilation, runtime tuning, and accelerator-aware optimization. Partner with systems engineers to integrate models into Cloudflare’s distributed inference infrastructure across a heterogeneous fleet of GPUs and next-generation accelerators. Drive improvements to model deployment workflows, including validation, rollout safety, observability, regression testing, and operational readiness. Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate customer requirements into scalable ML capabilities for Workers AI. Mentor engineers, contribute to technical direction, and raise the quality bar for production ML engineering practices across the team. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience Experience building, optimizing, and operating machine learning models in production environments. Strong proficiency with Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, or equivalent. Hands-on experience with inference optimization techniques for large-scale models, including quantization, batching, caching, compilation, and serving runtime tuning. Experience with large-scale inference serving frameworks or runtimes such as SGLang, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, ONNX Runtime, Triton, llama.cpp, or similar. Familiarity with LLMs, speech models, vision models, embeddings, multimodal models, retrieval-augmented generation, or other modern deep learning architectures. Experience optimizing models for GPUs or specialized accelerators. Strong understanding of production ML concerns, including evaluation, monitoring, model regressions, rollout safety, and reliability. Ability to work across ML and systems boundaries, including familiarity with distributed systems, networking, or serverless platforms. Track record of leading complex technical projects and mentoring other engineers. Bonus Points Experience contributing to open source ML tooling, model serving frameworks, or inference runtimes. Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. F or Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000 For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000 Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. Staff Backend Engineer - Mimir Query, Databases This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the USA time zones. What is Grafana Cloud? Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack. The Databases team owns and operates the telemetry databases that are Mimir for metrics , Loki for logs , Tempo for traces , and Pyroscope for profiles . Our databases are offered as a hosted service in Grafana Cloud, and additionally as on-premise solutions with Grafana Enterprise Metrics , Grafana Enterprise Logs , and Grafana Enterprise Traces . They are multi-tenant distributed systems implemented in Go and operating at scale on Kubernetes across all major Cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure). As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software.  Mimir Squad The Mimir squad has 3 sub-squads, Ingest, Storage, and Query, which together maintain the Mimir OSS project , and additionally own and operate Grafana Cloud Metrics across 3 major cloud providers. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI’s marketing team advances our mission by helping people and organizations understand what AI can make possible and how to put it to work responsibly. Industry product marketing connects our technology with the needs of specific markets, bringing customer insight into our decisions and helping customers move from interest to meaningful adoption. We are looking for product marketing leads across Life Sciences, Healthcare, and Financial Services. Each lead will own the strategy and execution for their industry and help shape OpenAI’s place in it. About the Role This is a senior leadership role that is responsible for shaping our go-to-market in a given vertical. You’ll make choices about priority use cases, shape our positioning, and align teams around a focused plan. You’ll bring evidence from the market into product and go-to-market decisions, build relationships with senior customer leaders, and stay close to execution. You’ll be accountable for an industry strategy that earns customer trust, increases adoption, and supports business growth. We’re looking for someone who can set a long-term direction, influence consequential decisions, and build the programs and customer evidence needed to deliver on it. In This Role You Will Own the industry strategy. Assess the market, choose priority segments and use cases, and define a clear plan for growth, including where we will not focus. Shape product and go-to-market decisions. Bring customer needs, market evidence, and competitive insight to Product, Research, and GTM leaders. Make clear recommendations and work through tradeoffs. Build executive customer relationships. Engage senior business and technical leaders on their priorities, AI opportunities, adoption barriers, and measures of success. Define our industry positioning. Explain where OpenAI can deliver differentiated value, grounded in customer realities and the capabilities and limitations of our products. Develop customer evidence. Work with customers and internal teams to document credible outcomes and ROI, understand what makes adoption successful, and build repeatable use cases. Lead cross-functional execution. Align Product, Sales, Solutions, Partnerships, Marketing, and Customer Success around priorities and outcomes. Turn the strategy into launches, executive programs, campaigns, and field enablement. Set the bar for credibility and trust. Partner with Policy, Legal, and Comms on accurate claims and responsible customer-facing guidance in regulated, high-trust industries. Be accountable for results. Set measures tied to adoption, pipeline contribution, and market growth. Evaluate performance with GTM partners and adjust priorities and investment as evidence changes. You Might Thrive in This Role If You 10+ years of experience leading product marketing, industry strategy, or enterprise go-to-market work at significant scale, with a track record of shaping strategy and delivering measurable business outcomes. Bring deep expertise in Financial Services, Healthcare, or Life Sciences, including how organizations buy, adopt technology, manage risk, and measure value. Have the credibility to advise C-suite customers and the judgment to challenge assumptions respectfully. Can influence consequential decisions across senior technical and commercial leaders without relying on formal authority. Understand complex enterprise technology and translate it into clear positioning and compelling narratives without overstating what it can do. Combine strategic judgment with hands-on execution. You can set a direction, write the first draft, and follow through across launches, customer programs, and field enablement. Use customer evidence, product usage, and market insight to make decisions and adapt quickly in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Bring strong writing and editorial judgment, technical curiosity, and a commitment to helping organizations adopt AI safely and responsibly. Workplace & Location This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Occasional travel will be required. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with banks, asset managers, insurers, and private capital firms to deploy production-grade AI systems in high-stakes financial environments. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development, embedding deeply with customers to translate frontier model capabilities into reliable, auditable systems that create measurable business impact. Our work turns early deployments into repeatable solution patterns, operating standards, and evaluation practices that scale across regulated financial institutions. About the Role As a foundational FDE manager, you’ll lead FDE through high-stakes, ambiguous financial services deployments and own technical and business value outcomes end to end. You’ll grow a team that can operate under pressure and help OpenAI learn from the field. You will work with customers who are experts in investment banking, trading, risk, compliance, underwriting, research, operations, or investment decision-making, translating complex workflows, data constraints, and regulatory requirements into production systems. You’ll partner closely with Product, Research, Sales, and GTM to ensure fieldwork informs roadmap priorities, drives new exploration, and supports safe deployment at scale. Your decisions will influence how OpenAI is trusted by the customers closest to our deployment work. Your success will be measured by how consistently your team ships, how clearly you deliver signal to Research and Product, and how durable your team and delivery model prove to be. This role is based in New York City We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. This role also will require travel up to 25%. In this role, you will: Lead and grow a team of FDE delivering production systems with frontier models Own end-to-end delivery outcomes through clarity, speed, tight coordination, and technical quality Codify what works into tools, playbooks, and roadmap inputs that create leverage for both OpenAI and our wider developer community Notice early indicators and raise them with urgency, whether in product behavior, customer environments, or delivery practices Use judgement to distinguish what requires action and what does not Set a high bar for FDE performance and support each person’s growth through direct, actionable feedback Define how we staff and support field teams that can scale without added complexity You might thrive in this role if you: Bring 10+ years of engineering or technical delivery experience, including 2+ years managing high-performing FDE or customer-facing engineers. Have led high-pressure technical projects from prototype to production. Write and review production-grade code across frontend and backend using Javascript or Python. Simplify complex work and make fast, sound decisions under pressure. Elevate team performance through clarity, not process. Operate with urgency in ambiguous or evolving environments. Translate field experience into sharp, actionable feedback for Product and Research. Build deep trust with your team by modeling calm, focus, and judgment when it matters most. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. descriptionAr: About the Team Our Executive Business Partners serve as trusted advisors and collaborators to OpenAI’s executives and leaders, bringing strong communication, sound judgment, and operational excellence to their teams. We elevate leadership impact by anticipating needs, streamlining processes, and providing comprehensive support so our leaders can focus on their highest-impact priorities. Through strong relationships and a deep understanding of business objectives, we help teams navigate complexity, achieve key milestones, and contribute to OpenAI’s growth and success. Our leadership team reflects OpenAI’s culture and core values and is a mission-driven, kind, and thoughtful group. We take pride in creating a work environment that fosters collaboration, open communication, and authenticity, making OpenAI an excellent place to work for highly accomplished professionals. OpenAI is expanding its presence across EMEA, building the teams and leadership needed to support our growth across the region. In this role, you will: Partner with our GM, UK & Nordics, our EMEA Communications leader, and a future EMEA Marketing leader. These leaders work closely with our Managing Director, EMEA, other regional GMs, and teams across Sales, Policy, Partnerships, and beyond to advance OpenAI’s presence in the region. You’ll help these leaders and their teams operate effectively by creating structure, driving coordination, and strengthening the operating cadence across markets, functions, and time zones. Working across regional business leadership, communications, and marketing, you’ll anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and build connections that support effective collaboration and execution. You might thrive in this role if you have: 5+ years experience in a cross-functional executive assistant role or similar support function. Successfully supported multiple leaders in the past. Worked in a hard tech startup or similar environment. Experience working across EMEA markets and collaborating with U.S.-based HQ teams. High cross-cultural EQ and ability to tailor communication styles for diverse stakeholders. Strong operational rigor — able to run cadences, track priorities, and maintain alignment across time zones. Comfortable supporting complex, rapid travel across international regions. Strong communication - being able to tailor a message appropriate to a specific audience (writing an email to a Senator vs. a Customer vs. an Exec). Discretion - this role will have exposure to sensitive knowledge so must be rock solid on confidentiality. Humility/diplomacy - this role has the potential to accrue power in a unique ways, but we want this person to be decisive and make noncontroversial decisions. Very fluent in Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Gmail, etc. and other modern productivity software, and are excited to learn and use new tools. Genuine interest in the technology we’re building and the transformative potential of AI. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form . No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link . OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Lisbon, London, Austin About the team The Zero Trust Connectivity team builds the hub that connects Cloudflare One and Zero Trust products such as Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare One Client, Cloudflare Tunnels, Gateway and Workers VPC. Powering this hub is a set of Rust-based services operating on every one of the data-centers that Cloudflare runs. These services route all of Cloudflare One traffic end to end. By leveraging Cloudflare's incredible infrastructure and programming languages such as Rust, this critical service is safe, performant and secure. As Cloudflare Zero Trust set of features evolves, this team is responsible for evolving these hub services to deliver those new capabilities while guaranteeing scalability and reliability as top priority. We are a team of engineers who obsess over building reliable services which leverage Cloudflare's unique architecture and global network footprint. You can read more about what we work on here: https://blog.cloudflare.com/introducing-cloudflare-one/ https://blog.cloudflare.com/from-ip-packets-to-http-the-many-faces-of-our-oxy-framework/ https://blog.cloudflare.com/workers-vpc-open-beta/   About the role As a software engineer on the Zero Trust Connectivity team, you will contribute across a wide range of technologies and systems to deliver new solutions that connect Cloudflare One products together. You will build connectivity in a user-space service that can identify and route flows across our global network. This work requires close collaboration with other teams while leveraging powerful frameworks and libraries that power many Cloudflare products. Our technology stack includes Rust, Linux networking, Clickhouse, SaltStack, Prometheus, AI harnesses, and our own Cloudflare Workers platform. We're looking for determined, curious, empathetic engineers to join our team!   Desirable skills, knowledge, and experience Programming experience in Rust Familiar with Layer 3 and Layer 4 Networking Systems-level programming experience in Linux Experience building large-scale, reliable, highly distributed systems Attention to detail and ability to solve complex customer problems Own solutions end-to-end and driving the design, development, and deployment process Able to work across teams and level common, sustainable solutions Creative, open-minded, collaborative problem solver Focus on clarity in written and verbal communication Leveraging AI coding assistants to accelerate development   Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €66,000-83,000 Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.   What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview pro

descriptionAr: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Role Overview We're seeking a senior product leader to own Cohere's Inference as a Service business end to end. Your primary responsibility will be to build and own the tools, data, and platform that turn Research plans and workload signals into concrete compute demand and manage allocations across the fleet. This is a hands-on technical role. You will build alongside researchers and engineers, working directly with code and data to prototype solutions, automate workflows, and deliver tools that teams use every day. You will combine technical judgment and program leadership to connect capacity planning with the deployment, scheduling, and optimization systems that make allocated compute usable. You will work across a broad range of Research workloads, understanding their different requirements and ensuring those needs shape the platform. Success means researchers can express their needs, understand their allocations, and use compute effectively as priorities and workloads change. In this role, you will: Build with Research. Work directly with researchers across pretraining, research inference, and other workloads. Treat these communities as core users, and translate their needs into improvements across compute services, tooling, and scheduling. Own Research demand and allocation systems. Own the roadmap and delivery of the tools, data, and platform used to capture demand, support allocation decisions, and manage allocations. Carry this work from requirements and design through adoption and ongoing improvement. Turn research plans into actionable demand. Develop systems that translate evolving plans and workload requirements into concrete capacity needs, including resource requirements, timing, and constraints. Connect capacity supply and demand. Partner with Capacity Planning, Research, and infrastructure teams to reconcile demand with available supply. Build the tools and workflows needed to evaluate scenarios, manage changes, and make allocation tradeoffs visible to decision makers. Build reliable data and useful tools. Create data models, views, and automation that show what researchers need, what capacity is available, what has been allocated, and how it is being used. Improve self-service workflows for requesting and managing compute. Connect allocations to workload execution. Partner with engineers working on Kubernetes deployments and scheduling systems so allocation plans reflect workload constraints and translate into resources that researchers can use. Improve allocation and scheduling efficiency. Work with engineers to evaluate optimization approaches, including solvers operating at fleet and local scheduling levels. Help define constraints and objectives, assess tradeoffs, and measure improvements in fleet utilization. Find and address systemic gaps. Use workload and fleet data to identify bottlenecks, unused capacity, and recurring manual work. Build durable improvements to the tools and systems behind those problems. Lead technical delivery across teams. Own plans, dependencies, and decisions across Research, Research Compute Services, Capacity Planning, and infrastructure engineering. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, Texas | Lisbon, Portugal About The Department Cloudflare’s Infrastructure group is responsible for building our global network. Our Hardware Engineering team helps research, develop, test, and deploy new equipment enabling 20% of the world’s internet traffic to be served smoothly. Deployed across 330 cities in 120+ countries, the hardware we select helps improve the security, reliability, and performance of the Internet. About The Role We need to make thoughtful infrastructure choices affecting a significant portion of the Internet. Hardware we work with includes GPUs, servers and components, as well as PDUs and network hardware. As a Hardware Systems Engineer, you will work with colleagues on the Engineering teams, Product and Performance teams, and Hardware Sourcing teams to design, qualify and maintain Cloudflare’s worldwide fleet of GPU servers. engage directly with vendors and work through the full technical qualification cycle Translate AI product and workload requirements into precise infrastructure specifications Identify gaps in the existing infrastructure stack and drive solutions across hardware, firmware, software, and operations Stay ahead of the AI hardware landscape — new silicon, new interconnects, new form factors — and bring informed, opinionated recommendations Build tooling and automation to support qualification workflows, performance analysis, and ongoing operational visibility Communicate your results and updates through blog posts and internal talks Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science Experience in AI infrastructure, systems engineering, or hardware platform engineering First-principles understanding of AI accelerator architecture: compute pipelines, memory hierarchy (HBM, GDDR), interconnect topology, and/or how workload characteristics map to hardware capabilities Hands-on experience qualifying AI server platforms — you've run NCCL tests, profiled collective operations, debugged NVLink errors, and chased down PCIe lane misconfigurations Understand rack-scale systems: high-density power (kW/rack, busbar, PDU), liquid cooling (rear-door, direct liquid, immersion), high-speed networking infrastructure, and/or physical layer constraints Experience with AI/ML frameworks (vllm, sglang) at the systems level — you understand what they demand from the hardware and where bottlenecks actually live Familiarity with AI server form factors: HGX, OAC, OAM, UBB, open rack standards, and the tradeoffs between them Scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, Go and Linux sysadmin); you build tooling to support your own work and the team's Strong written communication — you can write a rigorous technical specification and a crisp vendor requirements document Knowledge of performance benchmarking ; descriptionAr: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. Please note that this role will require you to be comfortable with working in-person at our NYC office 3 days/week. We will sponsor you for relocation if you need to move for this role. What You’ll Do Drive the scheduling process and communicate logistics to all candidates and hiring teams Build a world-class team by providing a high-touch “white glove” experience at every step of the interview process Act as the primary contact during virtual and in-person interviews Develop collaborative relationships with Talent team members, hiring managers, and interviewers Spot and flag descriptionAr: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! About the Role Cohere is in a unique and exciting position to grow our GTM team globally! We are expanding our Talent Team and are looking for a creative, high-performing go-to-market talent partner who is eager to take on a new challenge as we are in the early stages of building the Talent Acquisition function. In this role, you will master a new domain of recruiting, recruit world-class technical talent, and influence the scaling of a high-growth Canadian tech company. If you consider yourself resilient, collaborative, influential, and a lifelong learner, we’d love to hear from you! What You’ll Do As a Talent Partner for Cohere, you will: Own the full lifecycle recruitment process, attracting and recruiting top talent for GTM at Cohere. Make sure our candidates have a world-class recruiting experience with us. Work with hiring managers and leaders to create effective recruiting strategies. Keep us up-to-date with talent market and industry insights so we can make informed decisions. Keep track of recruiting funnels in Ashby our ATS, and update the progress regularly. Find creative ways to proactively source and recruit candidates to optimize the top of the funnel. Build relationships with diverse tech and talent communities. Bring in other exciting talent projects and take ownership of them! Attend and represent our Talent Acquisition team at industry conferences as well as plan and execute curated networking events. Who You Are 8+ years of go-to-market, full-cycle recruiting experience scaling high-growth teams (experience at startups is a plus). You are a creative problem solver and thrive under pressure. We are a fast-growing scale up and with that comes ambiguity and change. You are a natural influencer and enjoy working cross-functionally. You love data and take a data-driven approach to your recruiting. You are passionate about diversity, community, and ensuring an equitable recruiting process. You are naturally curious, with a keen interest in the AI industry, specifically around NLP, LLMs, and cutting-edge research in this space. Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. How and Where We Work: Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form , and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.
