descriptionAr: Hi 👋 I’m Rosalia , and I look after our Product Marketing team at Ashby. I started my career in Product Marketing and helped build the Sales Enablement function at HubSpot during its journey from startup to IPO. Since then, I’ve worked across RevOps and Customer Marketing at Procore and Meta, partnering with incredible teams to bring differentiated products to market. I first heard of Ashby through our Head of Content, Anum with whom I’d spent those early days at HubSpot, and was inspired by the level of thoughtfulness and operating principles I saw and read about. I joined Ashby in April of 2024 back in Product Marketing - bringing all these experiences together to help build a thoughtful, high-impact team. We’re a growing, tight-knit team - and we’re just getting started 🚀 We work closely with Product, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and every level of leadership, including closely with our CEO Benji . We’re seen as strategic partners, not a service desk. PMM at Ashby means influence, visibility, and ownership - and this role is a chance to get in early on a team with strong internal momentum at a company growing fast. We value technical curiosity, editorial clarity, and first-principles thinking. We avoid jargon, favor plain English, and aim to genuinely help customers understand what our product does and how it can help them. You don’t need a decade in PMM to succeed here - but you do need strong product instincts, clear writing, and a bias for building systems that scale. We’re looking for a Release Marketer who is excited about owning product releases. This role is for someone who thrives on the details but understands the bigger picture – someone who can clearly explain how a new feature or product benefits prospects and customers in their daily workflows and approach to talent acquisition. Someone who wants to work closely with Product and Engineering to understand how a feature works, and act as a translator for the front-line teams. That means translating product specs into the materials, messaging, and demos that power our releases. This person should feel excited about selling with value and obsess over customer use cases and how we tell our product story. From crafting one-pagers and recording crisp, clear product videos and walkthroughs, to running our product updates newsletter, to building internal enablement that keeps our whole team informed on what’s changed, you’ll help us tell our differentiated story and keep our launch velocity high. You’ll work across multiple product lines, so you’ll need to context switch easily. Organization, attention to detail, and the ability to juggle and coordinate across multiple teams are among the most important skills for this role. On any given week, you’ll be keeping several releases moving, each with its own Product Manager. Because we’ve built deep relationships with a thoughtful, engaged customer base, we’re often co-creating with them - sharing product materials that are actually read, used, and appreciated by people who see us as partners, not just vendors. This is a great fit for someone who enjoys being in the weeds of technical products, but also has a sharp editorial voice, a strong eye for design, strong product instincts, and loves to always be shipping. While this role will flex across multiple products, you’ll have the opportunity to grow into eventually owning a full product line. This role is also a great opportunity for someone who wants to flex across PMM and enablement skills, and work on product marketing initiatives that create more leverage for our teams. Your Background There is not a single background that is the perfect fit for this role. We care more about the skills and intrinsic capabilities you bring to the table, and could see someone from a number of different backgrounds being a good fit, including: A Solutions Engineer who loves narrative and wants to shape more than just demos An Early-stage AE who worked closely with Product A Product-minded builder with a technical background and customer empathy A GTM specialist with a strong lean for product taste What You’ll Do Release Products and Features Own go-to-market planning and execution for feature releases across multiple product lines. Work closely with Product Managers to shape value propositions, messaging, and demo strategies. Produce polished feature videos for use across social media, the website, and other marketing channels. Create assets including blog posts, one-pagers, demo videos, internal launch docs, and enablement materials. Turn features into clear customer value through videos, product walkthroughs, and content that make the benefit obvious. Partner with other product marketers on larger and bundled launches where support is needed. Keep the release engine moving and create leverage for your team Serve as a product expert and go-to resource for how features work and how we position to the market. Coordinate release promotion with Solutions Engineering, RevOps, Sales, CS & Support teams to ensure audiences across the organization are best-equipped through their channels. Own initiatives that keep the whole team informed on product changes, including our product updates newsletter to customers. Help maintain our product launch velocity by leveraging AI, automation, and building scalable systems to manage a high volume of releases, giving yourself time back for more high-leverage work. You Might Be a Fit If You You’re highly organized, and can keep multiple releases, owners, and deadlines moving at once without anything slipping. You’ve got an exceptional eye for detail - people consistently trust you as the final eye on something because you catch more than just typos every time . You can switch between products and contexts easily, and pick up a new feature quickly enough to explain it well. You’re the person people ping and say, “Can you just explain this feature in normal words?” and you actually can. You know how to

descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph This is a remote position based in Canada (East Coast Canada preferred, open to other time zones for exceptional candidates) . The Opportunity: As a Senior Product Designer at Grafana Labs, you will join a growing Product Design organization of more than 25 designers, researchers, engineers, and design leaders distributed across six continents. You will work within a 100% remote R&D organization, so strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship building skills will be essential to your success. As  Senior Product Designer for Grafana Cloud’s Knowledge Graph , you'll design experiences for the context layer of Grafana Cloud that powers our entity graph, entity catalog and RCA workbench. Knowledge Graph automatically discovers services, infrastructure, and databases from the telemetry teams already have, maps how they depend on each other, and runs anomaly detection. This gives engineers, SREs, and their agents an up to date picture of their systems. We want anyone to be able to understand a system and resolve an incident faster, without writing queries or maintaining alert rules, not just the one person who happens to know it best. Over time, you will develop deep expertise in your product area and associated customer and user personas, use cases, and workflows, which will enable you to design tailored, role-driven experiences. You will also have an opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Product Design team at Grafana by coaching and mentoring other designers, collaborating on team internal initiatives, and helping evolve new ways of working, learning, and having fun together as the team scales. What You’ll Be Doing: Enabling customers to easily understand and explore how their systems connect to each other. Find clear, simple ways to show complex, constantly-changing information without overwhelming the user Translate research and data to experiences that are easy to digest and break down complexity Tailor the experience to different target audiences, covering multiple user perspectives Work cross-functionally with peers and leaders in engineering, product management, technical writing, and GTM functions, as well as other members of the Product Design team Prioritise for delivering impact while balancing business priorities, customer wishes and technical considerations  Document user needs and pain points, design directions, UX trade-offs, and detailed designs for specific features and enhancements Execute research and contribute to quantitative and qualitative research initiatives with researchers, cross-functional collaborators, customers, and members of the Grafana user community What Makes You a Great Fit: 7+ years of relevant design experience working on B2B/enterprise software products, ideally designing tools and services for developers or other highly technical users A portfolio of effective designs for complex products delivered in a fast-paced environment Experience running qualitative research in complex fields, building empathy with users and humans, their needs and pain points even when you have very little in common with them Ability to make design decisions that appropriately balance business goals, product priorities, customer feedback, research insights, and technical considerations Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time-zones to iteratively ship and evolve products while keeping the end design vision in mind Attention to detail and willingness to learn about a complex, very technical product space Experience working in a fully-remote, fast-paced environment where you are expected to share openly, default to transparency, and embrace your autonomy Bonus Points For: Experience designing complex, data-dense interfaces with a focus on clarity Ability to rapidly gain an understanding of a technical domain and associated customer needs and user workflows in order to design effective experiences within that domain Domain knowledge or experience related to observability, cloud infrastructure, and/or database monitoring Experience helping design teams, especially at engineering led companies, level up their practice, collaboration with partner functions, and user and organizational impact When you apply, please: Provide an example of an experience where decision-making in a complex area is made easy through a well-curated UI. Add a sentence or two about what you believe makes it effective. Compensation & Rewards: In Canada, the Base compensation range for this role is CAD $ 150,822 - CAD $18

descriptionAr: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role As a member of Ramp's Fraud Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company and its customers against fraudulent activities. This position involves analyzing new account applications, monetary and non-monetary account activity to identify and mitigate risks associated with first-party and third-party fraud. We are seeking a detail-oriented professional who is adept at applying fraud detection techniques and leveraging data sources and tools to develop logical courses of action. In addition to technical acumen, this role requires strong interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively cross-functionally and with customers, external financial institutions, and law enforcement agencies. Ideal candidates are self-starters who are energized by ambiguity and love creating clarity. What You'll Do Analyze new account applications to detect potential fraud patterns, including identity theft, synthetic identities, and other high-risk behaviors. Evaluate transactional activity, identifying anomalies and irregularities indicative of fraudulent behavior. Thoroughly investigate alerts of first-party and third-party fraud, providing comprehensive documentation of findings. Investigate and facilitate customer card disputes, ensuring cases are resolved accurately and within network timelines. Use AI tools and automation to streamline investigations, and help develop and improve the processes and tooling behind them. Collaborate with internal teams, such as Credit Risk, Compliance, and Customer Support, to ensure timely resolution of fraud-related issues. Communicate directly with customers to verify account activity, resolve disputes, and gather necessary documentation during investigations. Liaise with external stakeholders, including financial institutions and law enforcement, to support investigations and facilitate recovery efforts when necessary. Stay updated on emerging fraud trends, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements to enhance fraud prevention and detection measures. Perform root cause analyses, document control breakdowns, and work with the strategy and engineering teams to improve fraud controls. Document procedures and proactively identify opportunities for operational process improvement. Work Schedule Requirements Fraud doesn't operate on a standard 9-to-5 schedule, and neither does this role. Candidates must have the flexibility to work nights, weekends, and holidays as part of a rotating schedule to ensure 24/7 fraud monitoring and response. This is essential to maintaining Ramp’s commitment to protecting its customers and minimizing risk around the clock. What You Need Minimum 2 years of experience in fraud prevention or investigations Experience within consumer/corporate/small business cards, payments, invoices, lending, or related industries Excellent collaboration, written and verbal communication skills Nice-to-Haves Experience with NACHA rules and regulations Experience with card network rules and regulations, including dispute and chargeback processes Experience with funds recovery processes, including hold harmless letters and ACH recalls Experience in high-growth startups Experience integrating AI into your daily work descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI Finance is responsible for ensuring the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. About the Role We are looking for an accountant to own an assigned portfolio of intercompany and investment accounting processes. You will manage recurring reconciliations, coordinate the accounting for intercompany funding, review transfer pricing calculations and journal entries, and partner with Technical Accounting on investments. A fundamental part of the role is understanding OpenAI's group structure, partnering closely with Tax on complex transactions, and providing guidance to the wider accounting group on intercompany flows. You will own work from source data through close, resolve routine issues independently, and improve processes within established policies and approval controls. You will identify matters requiring technical assessment early and bring clear analysis and supporting facts for review. You will be a pivotal interface between global finance teams, treasury, tax, and systems to support our mission-critical financial close and reporting processes. What You Will Do Develop and maintain an understanding of OpenAI's group structure, ownership relationships and intercompany arrangements and flows. Partner with Tax, Technical Accounting and your manager to assess complex intercompany transactions and coordinate implementation of agreed accounting treatments. Provide guidance to the wider accounting group on intercompany flows, accounting treatments and cross-entity accounting questions. Own monthly and quarterly close activities for assigned accounts, including reconciliations and resolution of reconciling items. Coordinate accounting for intercompany funding and settlements with Treasury and Tax, within established approval and execution controls. Review transfer pricing calculations prepared by the TP team for intercompany accounting accuracy, including entity, account, currency and FX rate treatment. Prepare and review assigned journal entries for accuracy, supporting evidence and consistency with approved accounting treatments and controls. Maintain investment accounting records and reconciliations, implement agreed accounting treatments, and partner with Technical Accounting and your manager on new transactions and technical assessments. Maintain close and audit support, document processes and controls, and work with systems teams to improve accounting workflows and resolve reporting issues. What You Will Bring Experience owning recurring accounting work through close, including balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, and investigation of reconciling items. A working understanding of US GAAP and multi-entity accounting, with the judgment to distinguish routine application of established policy from matters that need technical review. Familiarity with intercompany transactions, settlements, and foreign currency accounting. Experience with transfer pricing calculations or investment accounting is relevant to this role. Careful review habits and the ability to trace a calculation or journal entry to its source, explain discrepancies, and document how they were resolved. The ability to organize a close calendar, manage dependencies, and communicate clearly with Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and Technical Accounting. You follow through independently and raise issues with enough context for others to act. Comfort working with spreadsheets and accounting systems. Experience with Oracle FCCS or a similar consolidation system, internal controls, or audit support would be useful. What Success Looks Like Your assigned close activities are completed on time, with accurate entries and reconciliations that are easy to review. Reconciling items are resolved promptly, and unresolved issues have clear owners and next steps. Funding, transfer pricing, and investment accounting records reflect approved transactions and treatments, with complete supporting evidence. Documented processes and practical improvements reduce rework, while complex or unusual matters reach your manager early enough for a considered decision. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform. About the Role We’re looking for a Silicon Design Lead to drive architecture, microarchitecture, and implementation of key IP and subsystems for our AI hardware platforms. You will translate functional, performance, and security requirements into efficient silicon designs, owning technical decisions from architectural definition through implementation and integration. Part of this role will focus on hardware security implementation in close partnership with OpenAI’s Security team. While the Security team owns the overarching security architecture and requirements, you will translate those requirements into silicon microarchitecture and implementation, balancing security capabilities with performance, power, area, and design complexity. The other part of this role will focus on driving general silicon architecture/microarchitecture. In this role, you will: Own architecture, microarchitecture, and implementation of silicon IP and subsystems, from requirements and design specifications through integration and validation. Define hardware interfaces, data flows, and microarchitectural tradeoffs to meet functional, performance, power, and area requirements. Partner closely with OpenAI’s Security team to translate security architecture, requirements, and threat models into implementable hardware capabilities. Design and integrate hardware security mechanisms, including encryption, key management, access controls, isolation, and data protection across silicon subsystems. Evaluate architectural and implementation tradeoffs to ensure security capabilities meet functional and performance requirements. Collaborate with silicon architects, RTL, verification, firmware, and software teams to drive subsystem design, integration, and validation. Review and contribute to RTL implementations, ensuring designs align with architectural intent and system requirements. Evaluate existing and third-party IP, identify architectural or implementation gaps, and drive solutions across subsystem boundaries. You might thrive in this role if you: Have strong experience in silicon IP or subsystem-level architecture, microarchitecture, and implementation. Have owned hardware IP or subsystem designs from architectural definition through implementation and integration. Have experience implementing hardware security features such as memory encryption, key management, access controls, isolation, or secure boot. Understand how to translate functional and security requirements into hardware architectures, interfaces, and microarchitectural specifications. Have working knowledge of RTL design and coding proficiency in Verilog or SystemVerilog, with the ability to read, review, and contribute to RTL. Can evaluate performance, power, area, and complexity tradeoffs across silicon designs. Work effectively across security, silicon architecture, RTL, verification, firmware, and software teams to drive designs from concept through execution. Ideally, have broader SoC-level architecture or integration experience, though deep IP or subsystem-level expertise is sufficient. descriptionAr: About the Team People Innovation Labs is a product, design, and engineering team embedded in the People organization. We build AI-powered products that improve how OpenAI finds and supports exceptional talent and helps employees do their best work. Our work spans recruiting, HR, learning, performance, culture, and company-wide knowledge. We build new products from the ground up and work closely with teams across OpenAI to rethink existing workflows using our latest models. About the Role We’re looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager to lead execution across a portfolio of complex, cross-functional initiatives. You’ll partner closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and teams across the People organization to turn product strategy into clear, coordinated execution. You’ll establish the plans and operating structures needed to move work forward, align technical and operational teams, drive decisions, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure stakeholders are prepared for launches. Because we build new products from the ground up, the work does not end when a product launches. You’ll own ongoing engagement with users, including onboarding, training, hands-on support, and creating clear ways for people to share feedback. You’ll develop a deep understanding of how our products fit into users’ day-to-day work, what is working, and where they are struggling. You’ll bring those insights back to product, design, and engineering so the team can iterate quickly toward product-market fit. You’ll also help keep the team aligned with its broader objectives. You’ll maintain a clear view of priorities, progress, dependencies, risks, and outcomes across the portfolio and provide clear updates and recommendations to team and company leadership. In this role, you will: Independently lead complex, high-priority technical programs from early planning through launch, adoption, and ongoing iteration. Partner with product and engineering leadership to translate strategy and team objectives into clear, executable plans. Establish program structures, decision-making forums, operating cadences, and accountability across multiple teams. Align product, design, engineering, data, operations, and other stakeholders around priorities, responsibilities, and delivery plans. Partner closely with engineering leads to manage technical dependencies, sequencing, delivery risks, and launch readiness. Identify gaps in strategy or execution, develop recommendations, and drive the decisions needed to move work forward. Anticipate risks and blockers, clarify tradeoffs, resolve disagreements, and escalate decisions when needed. Own communication, enablement, change management, and rollout strategies for new products and workflows. Lead post-launch user engagement through onboarding, training, office hours, hands-on support, and other programs that drive adoption. Build trusted relationships with users and create an environment where they provide frequent, candid feedback. Observe how products fit into real workflows and identify points of confusion, friction, or unmet need. Combine user feedback, usage data, and operational signals to understand what is working and what needs to change. Translate user insights into clear themes and actionable recommendations for product, design, and engineering. Create tight feedback loops that help the team test assumptions, learn quickly, and iterate toward product-market fit. Define and track program health, adoption, user sentiment, and operational outcomes. Maintain visibility into priorities, progress, dependencies, and risks across the team’s portfolio. Prepare clear, decision-oriented updates and recommendations for senior leadership. Improve the team’s planning and execution practices while keeping processes lightweight. You might thrive in this role if you: Have 7+ years of experience in technical program management, product operations, or a similar role leading complex software initiatives. Have independently led multiple high-impact programs involving several technical and business teams. Have helped take new software products from early planning through launch, adoption, and rapid iteration toward product-market fit. Are energized by working directly with users and willing to provide hands-on support while a product is still new. Know how to build trust with users, ask good questions, and get candid feedback about what is and is not working. Can identify patterns across qualitative feedback, usage data, and operational signals and turn them into actionable recommendations. Have strong technical fluency and can partner with engineers on architecture, integrations, data dependencies, security, reliability, and delivery tradeoffs. Have led significant operational or organizational change alongside technical product delivery. Can influence senior leaders, drive difficult decisions, and build alignment across teams with competing priorities. Identify and address strategic or execution gaps without waiting for detailed direction. Communicate clearly and directly across technical teams, operational partners, users, and executives. Can move comfortably between organizational strategy and detailed, hands-on execution Bring structure to fast-moving work without adding unnecessary process. Are curious about how AI can change the way organizations operate and how people work. We partner closely with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Customer Education, Sales, and other teams to create content that is useful on its own and supports the broader customer journey. We build the tools, systems, and shared practices that help the whole team produce better work over time. About the Role We’re looking for a Product Content Creator to help create the next generation of AI-native marketing content. You’ll develop videos, interactive tutorials, live demos, written guides, and other experiences that help business audiences understand what AI makes possible and how it applies to their work. This is a hands-on creative role spanning demand generation and product adoption. You’ll explore product capabilities, build and test workflows, and produce content for campaigns that introduce people to useful ideas and help them put those ideas into practice. You’ll maintain evergreen campaign content and develop new adoption campaigns, using practical workflows, research, and thought leadership as source material. You’ll use Codex and other AI tools to prototype ideas and create experiences that would previously have required a larger production team. Strong judgment about the idea, the audience, and the finished experience matters as much as the ability to build it. You’ll partner with Product Marketing on positioning and product accuracy, Demand Generation on campaign goals and distribution needs, and Demo Studio on demonstrations and production. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this. In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible. About the Role Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This leadership role will be responsible for driving and implementing the overall sales strategy for our large enterprise segment, recruiting and leading a team of sales professionals, and achieving successful deployments with our customers. The ideal candidate will possess significant sales leadership experience and a comprehensive understanding of AI technologies. This leader will have the capability to adapt to a complex and fast-changing technology environment. Responsibilities will include customer acquisition, account management, owning executive relationships, and more. This individual will also need to be a proven leader who can effectively collaborate cross-functionally with product, marketing, developer relations, operations, and core GTM teams, while guiding and mentoring a sales team towards achieving business objectives. This role is based in Sydney, Australia. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: Lead a team of sellers. Partner with solutions to build and execute complex customer programs and projects. Manage consumption revenue forecasts. Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies. Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates. Support the development of company culture. Qualifications 10+ years leading Enterprise Sales teams. Selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service at a product-led growth company. Familiarity with the Financial Services industry in ANZ. Designing and executing complex deal strategies. Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies. Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.). Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence. Reporting on customer success activities. You might thrive in this role if you: Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their internal productivity and AI strategy. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor. Have a passion for or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future. Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision. Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions. Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a full-time remote opportunity. We are considering candidates based in the US and Canada only, within the Eastern or Central time zones. The Opportunity: As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer on the Grafana Catalog team, you will help grow the Grafana plugin ecosystem. Plugins are how Grafana connects to almost any data source, panel type or app, and the catalog has more than 300 of them from Grafana Labs, commercial partners and the open source community. We own the full plugin lifecycle. Developers build plugins with our tooling, publish them to the catalog, and users discover, install and update them in Grafana and Grafana Cloud. We are also building the Grafana Marketplace , which lets partners and independent developers sell their plugins to Grafana users. It is in pilot today and you will help us take it from there. What You’ll Be Doing: Some of the things we own: The Grafana Marketplace: paid plugins, publisher onboarding, and how customers buy and get access to them The plugin catalog in grafana.com and inside Grafana, where users search, compare and discover plugins Plugin installation and management in Grafana and Grafana Cloud Plugin delivery: publishing, signing, validation and the CDN that serves plugins to every Grafana Cloud instance Plugin review: every plugin published to the catalog goes through our review process before it reaches users Developer tooling and developer portal that helps develop the plugins A typical “day in the life” could include: Building new Marketplace features across the Grafana frontend, our Go services and grafana.com Improving how users find and install plugins, for both humans and agents like Grafana Assistant Making it easier and faster for developers to build, test and publish plugins Automating and improving the review process that every published plugin goes through Supporting the operations and reliability of plugin installs and delivery in Grafana Cloud Talking to plugin developers and partners and turning their feedback into roadmap items Coming up with suggestions for process improvements Working closely with the rest of the Grafana Division We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. What Makes You a Great Fit: You know how to transform ideas into working code, you are able to design a solution, get feedback and deliver large projects. You are a self-driven individual who understands the power of feedback loops in making roadmap decisions and driving our product forward. You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action, and willing to take on any challenge You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs. You are an excellent communicator and you enjoy collaboration You are comfortable working in a remote-first company Requirements: Solid experience with Golang & Typescript Experience with React and building user-facing web applications Experience with Kubernetes & microservices Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others Experience participating in an on-call rotation and performing operations/SRE tasks Bonus Points For: You have built or published a Grafana plugin You have worked on a marketplace, app store or package registry, or on billing and licensing You have built developer tooling such as CLIs, SDKs or CI pipelines used by other engineers You have strong experience working with a Product Manager or external stakeholders In US, the OTE (On-Target Earnings)/Base compensation range for this role is USD $167,143 - $200,572. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada.  The Opportunity:  We build Tempo , the open-source distributed tracing backend behind Grafana Cloud Traces and Grafana Enterprise Traces (GET). Tempo makes it easy to search traces, generate metrics from spans, and connect tracing data with logs, metrics, and profiles across the Grafana stack. 2026 is an inflection point for Tempo. After a major architectural upgrade and the launch of TraceQL metrics, we are shifting from foundational work to product and operational excellence, and evolving Tempo from a SaaS database into a platform that powers Grafana’s next generation of observability products (App Observability, Asserts, Traces Drilldown, and AI-driven assistants). Over the next year, you will help us: Make Grafana Cloud Traces “just work” for customers by eliminating rough edges, confusing limits, and hidden failure modes. Achieve operational excellence at scale as we grow from close to 50 cells today into triple digits this year, with autoscaling, parameterized rollouts, and aggressive toil reduction. Evolve Tempo into a platform enabler: higher-density APIs, trace aggregation, TraceQL metrics math, and machine/LLM-friendly interfaces that downstream products and agents can build on. Push performance further: faster query latency at hundreds of MB/s ingestion and performant 30-day query ranges to match competitors. Prepare Tempo for an agent-driven world: larger, burstier, higher-cardinality workloads, and new categories of AI-powered workflows, such as assistant-driven triage and “why is this slow?”- style investigations. What You’ll Be Doing:  As a Senior Engineer on Tempo, you will own technical direction on the hardest problems in our roadmap and raise the bar across the team. Deliver significant technical projects. Take well-scoped, multi-month initiatives from problem framing through rollout, e.g., trace aggregation APIs, Limitless Tempo, autoscaling cells and customer limits, or query engine improvements. Partner with Staff engineers and the tech lead on broader, cross-team direction. Own major components of Tempo. Contribute to and own parts of ingestion, storage, query, and metrics generation. Write and present design docs, participate in design reviews, make sound trade-offs on performance, cost, and complexity, and document the “why” for the team. Build APIs for humans and agents. Help shape the next generation of Tempo’s interfaces (structured, deterministic, discoverable) so that Act 3 products, LLM-driven assistants, and external integrators can build on Tempo reliably. Contribute to operational excellence. Own outcomes for the areas you build against concrete SLOs (P99 write latency, incident recurrence, TCO per ingested GB), and help move the team toward Zero Ops through automation, parameterized rollouts, and actionable alerts. Collaborate with Product and sibling teams. Work with PMs and with App Observability, Asserts, Drilldown, and Grafana Assistant teams to understand how Tempo gets consumed and to ship what unblocks them. Mentor and support engineers. Raise the bar through thorough code review, constructive design feedback, and pairing, especially with junior and mid-level engineers. Participate in on-call for the services you help build, and contribute to incident response and post-incident learning. Contribute to open source. Tempo is OSS. You will engage the community, review external contributions, and contribute to the project in the open. We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. Example problems you could work on These are the kinds of projects landing in 2026: Trace aggregation and higher-density APIs: extend TraceQL metrics, design LLM-friendly response types, and make Tempo a first-class data source for Grafana’s AI assistant. Autoscaling end-to-end: customer limits and Tempo cells, with hysteresis, predictive scaling for spikes, and safe scale-down. Agent-scale ingestion and query: guardrails for bursty, high-cardinality, agent-generated workloads. Query performance: new data formats, smarter query pipelines, targeted optimizations for co

We are considering candidates from US and Canada only (EST time zone).  The Opportunity: The Grafana Cloud Observability department is focused on enabling developers to understand the health and performance of their applications and infrastructure in any environment by providing tools to instrument their code, ingest observability data into Grafana Cloud and visualize and explore it. In this role, you will be part of the Cloud Integrations team. We develop  our portfolio of integrations that allow customers to collect, visualize and act on telemetry from various systems and applications.  The software you will create is a core building block for the users of Grafana Cloud, and has direct impact on Grafana Cloud’s out of the box experience.  Our work is built on Open Source technologies such as Prometheus and OpenTelemetry, which you will also have the opportunity to actively contribute to.    What You’ll Be Doing: You will bring your software engineering expertise to develop the tooling that powers our portfolio of cloud integrations and observability apps; working to develop, maintain and scale our infrastructure observability features in Grafana Cloud. We’re looking for someone who can work across the full stack: Frontend - written in Typescript / React Backend - written in Golang Monitoring Mixins - written in Jsonnet Day to day, that looks like: Ship features end to end, from the UI a user clicks through to the backend services behind it and the dashboards and alerts that ship with each integration Move between parts of the stack as the work demands. Some weeks are a React panel, some weeks a Go service, some weeks a Jsonnet mixin Own projects from problem statement to production, including talking to users and checking whether what you shipped actually worked Represent the team's work outside the team: write the design proposals, run the demos, and make the case for our roadmap in cross-team discussions Contribute upstream to Prometheus, OpenTelemetry and Grafana Alloy where our work touches them Join the on-call rotation for the services you own We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. As we have embraced a remote-first approach and our engineering team is primarily remote, it is essential to possess strong communication skills and the ability to work independently. We provide support and hold regular meetings through video calls to ensure effective collaboration and alignment. What Makes You a Great Fit: Interest in working across the full stack, with a product-focused mindset. You start from the user problem and are comfortable deciding what to build, not only how to build it Experience on both the backend and the frontend. We use Go and TypeScript; solid experience with comparable languages translates well Fluency with AI-assisted development. You use coding agents and LLM tooling as part of how you work, and you have a clear view of where they speed things up and where they get in the way Comfort being visible. You raise concerns early, advocate for your team's work across the org, and turn quiet good work into decisions other people can see and act on Working knowledge of the observability ecosystem: Prometheus, Grafana dashboards, alerting, and what it takes to run these systems in production Strong written communication. Most of our decisions happen in docs, issues and pull requests across several time zones Bonus Points For: Experience contributing to or maintaining Open Source projects, with evidence of successful pull requests and community collaboration Experience working on Developer Tooling with a large user base Experience building Grafana plugins, apps or dashboards Familiarity with Grafana Alloy, the OpenTelemetry Collector, or similar telemetry pipeline tooling Experience writing Jsonnet, or another configuration-as-code language You have been on-call for the systems you instrument, so you know what a useful alert looks like In US, the OTE (On-Target Earnings)/Base compensation range for this role is USD $167,143 - $200,572. descriptionAr: About the Team The AI Deployment Manager (ADM) team enables organizations to turn OpenAI products into real, sustained impact through world-class enablement and training execution. Our mission is to help customers successfully adopt and operationalize AI across their organizations. We partner with enterprises to translate the potential of OpenAI’s technology into durable capability—through structured training, technical enablement, and scalable deployment programs. By helping customers move from experimentation to production, the ADM team accelerates time-to-value, deepens meaningful adoption, and helps make OpenAI indispensable to how organizations work. About the Role The AI Deployment Manager, Builder role is a specialist post-sales technical enablement role focused on delivering high-impact enablement and adoption services across OpenAI’s product suite. You will design and deliver technical learning experiences covering OpenAI APIs, Codex, agents, evaluations, and related platform capabilities. You will work with engineers, AI and platform teams, administrators, security stakeholders, product leaders, and executive sponsors. This role blends deep technical fluency, instructional design, and customer advisory. You will lead live trainings, workshops, and adoption interventions for audiences ranging from hands-on builders to executive leaders, helping customers understand not just what OpenAI’s products can do, but how to use them effectively in real-world contexts. Success in this role means accelerating customer confidence, increasing product adoption, helping customers progress toward production use, and turning lessons from individual engagements into resources and practices that benefit many customers. This role is based in San Francisco or New York. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: Own the technical enablement of OpenAI products, including OpenAI APIs, Codex, Agents, Evaluations and other platform capabilities, helping define effective enablement patterns that support adoption across customer segments Lead customer training and enablement across the full customer lifecycle, from initial onboarding through expansion, optimization, and long-term adoption. Design and deliver high-impact training engagements, including onboarding sessions, advanced capability trainings, executive briefings, hackathons, and hands-on workshops for audiences ranging from senior leaders to working teams. Drive customer activation, sustained usage, and measurable business value through structured enablement and deployment programs designed for durable adoption at scale Partner closely with Sales, Solutions Architecture, and Product teams to define an effective enablement plan tailored to each customer’s use case, goals, and technical needs. Partner closely with Sales, Solution Architects, Delivery Leads to drive adoption across our core product suite. Develop and refine reusable training assets, playbooks, and best practices based on patterns observed across customers and regions. Gather customer feedback from training and enablement engagements, synthesize themes across accounts, and relay insights to internal stakeholders to inform product and program improvements. Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for designated product areas, building deep expertise, supporting internal enablement, identifying emerging customer use cases for new product surfaces, and aggregating customer feedback to inform product development. You’ll thrive in this role if you: Have 4+ years of experience in customer-facing or instructional roles, engaging C-level and senior technical audiences in complex enterprise environments. Possess exceptional presentation and communication skills, particularly when conveying the value of technical concepts clearly to senior and executive-level audiences. Strong technical depth across software engineering, the software development lifecycle, and APIs, with a practical understanding of how AI systems are built, evaluated, and operated in production, including RAG, evaluation strategies, agentic systems and key tradeoffs. Proven experience leading structured technical trainings, such as API bootcamps, workshops, or enablement sessions, with the ability to design learning journeys, handle live questions, and reason through problems in real time. Strong ability to connect technical features and capabilities to concrete business outcomes such as productivity, efficiency, cost reduction, risk mitigation, or revenue impact. Have a humble attitude, an eagerness to help others, and a desire to pick up whatever knowledge you're missing to make both your team and our customers succeed. Comfortable thinking on their feet in live customer settings, adapting quickly to new information, shifting priorities, and real-time questions while maintaining clarity, ownership, and momentum. Are personally committed to fostering the safe and ethical evolution of AI. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the SMB Marketing team helps small and medium-sized businesses understand and adopt ChatGPT Business and OpenAI’s B2B solutions. We build a deep understanding of business owners and teams, shape relevant product narratives, and drive awareness, adoption, and growth. We take a data-driven approach to understand SMB audiences, uncover customer needs, and translate AI capabilities into practical business value. We partner closely with Growth, Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Product, Research, Communications, and Design to deliver a cohesive customer experience across discovery, evaluation, purchase, adoption, and expansion. About the Role We are hiring a Portfolio Product Marketing Lead to define and scale OpenAI’s global audience marketing strategy for small and medium-sized businesses. This leader will own how business owners, decision-makers, and teams understand, evaluate, adopt, and grow with ChatGPT Business and OpenAI’s SMB B2B solutions. This is a highly strategic and hands-on leadership role where you will shape clear, compelling narratives that show how AI helps SMBs solve everyday business challenges. You will build the content, customer stories, thought leadership, events, and integrated programs that drive ChatGPT Business subscriptions, team adoption, seat expansion, and long-term growth. You will partner closely with Growth, Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Product, Communications, Research, and Data Science to make OpenAI a trusted partner for SMBs adopting AI and turning it into measurable business value. This role is ideally based in San Francisco, CA, with a hybrid schedule of three days per week in the office. In This Role, You Will: Own SMB audience strategy and positioning for ChatGPT Business and SMB B2B solutions, translating customer needs into differentiated messaging and clear reasons to adopt. Lead thought leadership and content strategy, using practical education, demos, and customer stories to show how SMBs can put AI to work and achieve measurable results. Develop go-to-market programs for priority SMB industries, equipping Sales, Partnerships, and Growth teams with tailored narratives, proof points, and enablement. Partner with Growth and channel teams on integrated campaigns, lifecycle marketing, communities, and events that drive self-serve conversion, sales-assisted opportunities, retention, and expansion. Partner with Product Marketing and Product teams to turn roadmap innovations into audience-relevant launches, customer education, and adoption programs. Build and lead a high-performing team, establishing measurement frameworks to assess engagement, conversion, adoption, and revenue impact. You Might Thrive in This Role If You: Have 12+ years of experience in B2B marketing or go-to-market leadership, including building programs that drive SMB adoption and growth at a technology, SaaS, or AI company. Understand how SMB owners and teams evaluate, buy, and adopt software—from resource constraints and proof of value to self-serve and sales-assisted buying journeys—and how AI can improve their everyday workflows. Can translate complex technology into clear positioning, audience narratives, and thought leadership that resonate across SMB segments. Have built content and enablement programs spanning customer education, practical use cases, customer stories, webinars, workshops, and community engagement. Are highly analytical, with experience connecting marketing investments to conversion, adoption, retention, expansion, and revenue outcomes. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Remote within: US, Canada, UK, Portugal About the role New vulnerabilities can be exploited soon after public disclosure, leaving application owners little time to patch. Cloudflare can drastically reduce this exposure through managed WAF protections, ad-hoc emergency policies, and tools that help customers identify affected applications and remediate them. As Senior Product Manager for Zero-Day Protection, your goal is to help protect more than 20% of the Internet from HTTP-exploitable vulnerabilities and attacks. You will own the strategy, roadmap, execution, and customer experience for Cloudflare’s zero-day protection products, beginning with WAF Managed Rules. The role also shapes how Cloudflare helps customers identify affected applications, deploy temporary mitigations, investigate active exploitation, and remediate vulnerable software. Partner with other product and engineering teams to help customers identify exposure, deploy mitigations, investigate attacks, and remediate vulnerable software. Prioritize shared security primitives, telemetry, and APIs that make emergency protections easier to automate across Cloudflare’s security products. Define workflows for creating, testing, deploying, and auditing ad-hoc emergency policies when a managed detection is not sufficient for a customer’s environment. Partner with the Cloudflare Security Research team to turn threat intelligence, vulnerability research, and detection opportunities into product priorities. Security provide technical guidance; the PM brings customer impact and product context. Establish feedback loops with Support, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and customers. Turn recurring friction and unmet needs into product priorities. Customer empathy and strong product judgment, especially for complex technical workflows. Excellent written and verbal communication for technical and non-technical audiences. Strong cross-functional leadership across Cloudflare Security Research, Engineering, Support, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Legal, Communications, and other product teams. Develop workspace and entitlement systems that connect purchases and subscriptions to product access for individuals and teams. Keep charges and product access correct when requests are retried, updates arrive late, or another service fails. Build metering systems, data pipelines, and APIs that turn large volumes of usage into accurate bills, timely spending information, and records that are easy to trace and verify. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI’s Legal team helps address the cutting-edge legal questions that arise from developing and deploying advanced AI. The Security and Public Sector Legal team helps protect OpenAI’s technology, systems, data, and people and supports the safe and responsible use of our tools. We work closely with technical and operational teams to provide practical advice on novel, consequential, and fast-moving issues. About the Role We are seeking a counsel to help lead legal responses to cybersecurity and AI safety incidents. This is an opportunity to bring deep incident response expertise to some of the hardest questions in AI, and help build the legal frameworks and practices for answering them. You will advise on complex cybersecurity incidents, from discovery through to resolution, and also help develop our response to incidents involving the safety of our models and tools. AI safety incident response is a new and rapidly evolving legal practice area. Your work will help define how frontier AI companies investigate and respond to safety events such as unexpected model behavior, degradation of safeguards, harmful uses of our services, and potential harm to third parties—often where established legal standards do not yet exist. Working directly with Security, Safety, Product, Engineering, and colleagues across Legal, you will advise on consequential decisions where established approaches may offer little guidance. We are looking for a practical, dynamic lawyer who can turn incomplete information into clear recommendations, exercise sound judgment on novel questions, and follow matters through to resolution. You will help establish the facts, assess risks, and guide investigations, communications, remediation, and reporting. You will also turn lessons from individual incidents into durable response processes, helping further develop a legal function that evolves alongside the technology. This role is based in Washington, D.C. or San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will be: Serving as legal lead on assigned cybersecurity and AI safety incidents, coordinating fact development, legal analysis and advising, cross-functional escalation, and follow-through with the response team. Working with investigators to understand incident scope, attack paths, root cause, and affected systems and data, and potential third-party impacts, while helping teams distinguish established facts from gaps in the evidence. Managing outside counsel and third party service provider engagements necessary to incident response. Serving as key Legal point of contact for cross-functional teams. Partnering with Privacy, Product, Regulatory, and other counsel to assess notification and reporting obligations, advise on timely customer and user communications, and coordinate third-party outreach and incident-related information sharing with industry peers and government partners. Preparing concise incident updates and decision materials that distinguish established facts, uncertainties, options, and recommended next steps. Developing severity-based escalation criteria, response playbooks, exercises, and clear decision and handoff processes for cybersecurity and AI safety incidents, adapting established practices to emerging model risks. Supporting post-incident reviews, tracking agreed corrective actions, and turning lessons into practical improvements to safeguards and response processes. You might thrive in this role if you have: A JD and a license or qualification to practice law in your jurisdiction. 5+ years of relevant experience. Relevant legal experience managing cybersecurity or privacy incident responses or comparable complex technology investigations at a technology company, law firm, or government agency, including work with technical teams, other counsel, and communications partners. The ability to translate technical findings into practical legal advice, with a working understanding of technical information. Sound judgment under time pressure, clear communication of uncertainty, and an understanding of when to act, seek specialist advice, or escalate. Clear, concise writing and the ability to keep cross-functional teams aligned through changing facts and competing priorities. Ownership of details and follow-through, paired with collaborative work with colleagues who bring different expertise. A strong interest in the novel challenges of AI safety and a willingness to help develop new approaches. Direct AI incident experience is helpful; strong transferable incident response skills are welcome. Availability to participate in time-sensitive incident response, including occasional work outside normal business hours. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. L&D should make them good at all of it. Turn AI progress into operating change. Know what our Investigative Copilot (specialist-facing) and AskRamp (fully agentic) can do and how well they do it. When that moves, change staffing, workflows, training, and expectations to match. Build and own the voice of the CX specialist to Product and Engineering. A genuine AI transformation you were on the front lines of in the last 18-24 months. You changed how a team’s work gets done and kept it running in production. You can explain what improved, what failed, and what you learned. Exceptional intellectual horsepower and natural curiosity , demonstrated through outstanding, standout performance across past roles in demanding environments. Experience leading teams and developing reports , with sound judgment about organizational design, incentives, and performance management. Analytical depth you use yourself: you can build or audit a capacity model, challenge a metric, diagnose an operating problem, or review an AI agent session to find the flaws. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. We're hiring Solution Architects to help the world's best engineering organizations figure out what AI-native software development actually looks like in production. This is a deeply technical, post-sale role embedded inside SpaceXSI's most strategic enterprise accounts. You'll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI. Solution Architects sit at the center of long-term customer transformation. RESPONSIBILITIES: Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI-Native Development: Roll out SpaceXSI across strategic engineering organizations; configure environments, design workflows, and run hands-on enablement sessions; help developers integrate SpaceXSI into real production workflows, not isolated demos; drive fast time-to-value and durable adoption across teams; identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly Expand SpaceXSI Across the Organization: Identify where SpaceXSI should expand next inside the customer environment; help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company-wide adoption; design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups; partner with customers to operationalize AI-assisted development at scale; work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments Become a Trusted Technical Partner: Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders; lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions; advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy; coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress; help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI-native development evolves Drive Real Customer Outcomes: Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact; connect SpaceXSI usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality; help customers communicate the value of SpaceXSI internally and build momentum for broader adoption; turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization Help Make SpaceXSI Indispensable: Deepen workflow adoption and long-term product stickiness; monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on SpaceXSI over time; support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction; help customers build workflows they can't imagine operating without Shape the Future of the Product: Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering; identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements; help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships; turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling Experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: The ability to work hands-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership A strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences Strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams High ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity A passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering
