descriptionAr: About Us At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale. With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world. Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater. About the Role You will be LangChain's dedicated cloud alliance lead for AWS, owning the relationships and revenue motions that make these partnerships produce real pipeline. This is a senior individual contributor role sitting within the Partnerships team where you'll be close to the product, close to the field, and expected to drive results without a lot of hand-holding. You'll own co-sell execution and marketplace presence end-to-end, working with cloud partner teams, field sellers, and LangChain's GTM organization to turn partner relationships into closed deals. What You'll Do Co-sell and pipeline Own and grow LangChain's co-sell motion with AWS: manage joint pipeline, coordinate deals with AWS field teams, and drive sourced and influenced revenue. Partner with LangChain sales leadership to define priority co-sell accounts, map territories to AWS coverage, and run co-sell plays region by region. Keep ACE hygiene high across the sales team so that opportunity sharing, acceptance, and launch become routine rather than a partnerships-team chore. Marketplace Own LangChain's AWS Marketplace presence end to end: listings, private offers, CPPO through channel partners, and program enrollment. Operate our marketplace GTM platform (Suger today) and extend referral and offer automation so sellers can transact through Marketplace without partnerships-team involvement. Programs and funding Operationalize AWS funding mechanisms across the team: MDF (market development funds for co-marketing), proof-of-concept credits, ISV Accelerate benefits, and any strategic collaboration funding we secure. Pursue AWS competency and specialization programs that strengthen our positioning with AWS sellers. Track funding drawn down against funding available and report it monthly. Executive and partner relationships Own LangChain's working relationships at AWS: partner development managers, ISV sales managers, Marketplace category leads, and the Bedrock and AgentCore partner teams. Build executive sponsorship on both sides, and run a joint business plan with AWS that sets shared goals and a review cadence. Navigate the coopetitive dynamic: partner closely with AWS on Bedrock and AgentCore while differentiating LangGraph and LangSmith where AWS has competing offerings. Field enablement and marketing Equip LangChain sales, solutions engineering, and marketing with better-together messaging, competitive positioning, and joint sales plays for AWS accounts. Partner with marketing on co-branded campaigns, content, and events that generate pipeline, including re:Invent, AWS Summits, and joint customer programs. Communicate results clearly to internal stakeholders, including a monthly readout on pipeline, Marketplace, and program activity. What You'll Bring 6+ years in cloud alliances, partner sales, or business development, with direct, hands-on ownership of an AWS relationship. A track record of scaling a hyperscaler co-sell motion, not just starting one: you have taken a working AWS alliance to materially higher Marketplace share, pipeline, or partner-sourced revenue, and you can describe the mechanisms that got you there. Deep working knowledge of AWS Marketplace transactions and programs: private offers, CPPO, ACE, ISV Accelerate, and the funding programs available to ISVs. Experience operating a marketplace GTM platform such as Suger, Tackle, or WorkSpan, including referral and offer automation. Experience shaping and running a joint business plan with a hyperscaler, including executive sponsorship on both sides. Enough technical foundation to speak credibly with builders. You do not need to write code, but you need to understand how LangGraph, LangSmith, and LangChain fit into a customer's AWS stack. Experience in a startup or high-growth environment where you set the operating rhythm for a partner motion rather than inheriting one. Strong operational discipline: you manage pipeline in the CRM, track partner activity, and report results clearly to internal stakeholders. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with comfort owning senior relationships at a large cloud organization and resolving conflict constructively across company lines. Nice to Have's Prior experience inside AWS in partner sales, ISV, or Marketplace roles, with a working understanding of how co-sell decisions and seller compensation work internally. Experience with commercial contracts with AWS like SCAs. Existing relationships across the AWS ISV, field, Marketplace, and Bedrock partner teams. Familiarity with the AI/ML ecosystem: how LLMs, agents, and developer tooling fit into enterprise stacks. Experience with AWS partner programs speci

About the Role We’re growing our IP team and seek an experienced attorney to lead OpenAI’s global trademark litigation and disputes strategy, and oversee our broader trademark and brand protection practice. You will lead complex, high-stakes trademark litigation and enforcement matters around the world, develop strategies to protect OpenAI’s brands in a rapidly evolving technological landscape, and provide practical, business-oriented advice on novel trademark and brand-related issues. This role is highly cross-functional across OpenAI, including work across our Legal, Communications, Global Affairs, Marketing, Product and Executive teams This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: Lead global trademark litigation and disputes, including complex infringement, unfair competition, dilution, and other brand-related litigation, from initial assessment through resolution. Develop and execute global trademark litigation and enforcement strategies, including managing outside counsel, directing litigation strategy, assessing risk, and advising senior leadership on significant disputes. Lead and develop OpenAI’s trademark team, overseeing attorneys and legal professionals responsible for trademark clearance, prosecution, portfolio management, enforcement, dispute resolution, brand protection, and marketing counseling. Stay current on relevant laws, regulations, and industry trends, and provide updates and legal guidance to company leadership and stakeholders. Build scalable processes and frameworks for trademark risk assessment, enforcement prioritization, outside counsel management, and cross-functional decision-making. Provide clear, practical, and strategic advice to senior leadership, balancing legal risks, commercial priorities, reputational considerations, and long-term brand protection. You might thrive in this role if you: Have 10+ years of leading complex trademark litigation and disputes, including significant responsibility for litigation strategy, case management, and resolution, including substantial experience at technology companies and law firms. Have personally developed and executed strategies for complex, high-stakes trademark litigation and disputes, leading matters from initial assessment through resolution, including direct engagement with opposing counsel and other key stakeholders. Have experience developing and executing global trademark portfolio strategies, including clearance, prosecution, enforcement, and brand protection, aligned with business priorities and growth. Communicate complex legal and business issues clearly, exercise sound judgment in navigating legal uncertainty, and provide practical, strategic recommendations under pressure. Work effectively with cross-functional teams, legal operations, outside counsel, and senior stakeholders while managing multiple urgent matters. Bring intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, a strong sense of ownership, and a willingness to challenge assumptions respectfully and learn from feedback. descriptionAr: About the Team The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments worldwide. We work across the full funnel, from acquisition and activation to retention and monetization, through product experiments, in-product improvements, performance marketing, creative development, and AI-powered workflows. The International Growth team works with regional leaders in priority markets to identify the user needs and product gaps that matter most for adoption, usage, and monetization. We turn market priorities into product roadmaps and growth plans, then partner with engineering, research, design, data science, marketing, finance, policy, and partnerships to test and ship improvements. We combine product strategy with hands-on growth operations. We account for local behavior, competition, and product experience while building shared capabilities such as segmentation, lifecycle journeys, and experimentation systems. We measure what ships, adapt it to the market, and scale approaches that work across markets. About the Role We’re looking for a growth lead for Brazil to shape and execute ChatGPT’s growth plans. You’ll partner with regional and market leaders to understand users across Brazil, prioritize the biggest growth opportunities across markets, and turn those priorities into product improvements, funnel optimizations, and performance marketing tests. You’ll work across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, collaborating with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Partnerships, and Marketing teams to influence priorities and ship measurable impact. The role combines product growth and funnel optimization with performance marketing: connecting audience, message, creative, and channel learnings to better in-product journeys. In this role, you will: Partner with regional and market leaders to set a Brazil growth plan and market-level roadmap priorities, with clear hypotheses, owners, dependencies, and measurable outcomes. Use user research, funnel and cohort data, and competitive insight to find local friction and prioritize the opportunities that matter most to users. Run performance marketing tests in collaboration with regional marketers across relevant channels, creators, and partners; use incrementally, CAC, payback, and LTV to decide what to scale. Design and run rigorous experiments across onboarding, activation, repeat usage, re-engagement, and paid conversion; measure incremental impact and iterate. Work with Product, Engineering, Design, and Data Science partners to prototype, test, and ship locally relevant experiences. Partner with regional Marketing and central media teams to brief and prioritize audience, positioning, creative, and channel tests based on the regional plan and market priorities. Own the regional growth scorecard with market-level views across acquisition, retention, paid conversion, and unit economics, distinguishing incremental user and revenue gains and learnings. Connect priority use cases, product improvements, and acquisition plans into a coherent journey from first exposure to repeated value. Run the growth operating cadence with regional and market leaders, aligning central and local partners on results, trade-offs, dependencies, and next steps. Build and operate segmentation, lifecycle journeys, growth tooling, performance marketing and product experimentation capabilities that can be scaled across markets. You might thrive if you have: 10+ years of experience across product growth, growth marketing, data science, or growth strategy and operations, with hands-on execution in a fast-moving technology company. A user-first track record of turning local research and behavior into product and growth priorities, then shipping improvements with measurable impact. Strong command of acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization funnels, including technically rigorous experimentation and interpretation. Practical performance marketing experience across audience, channel, creative, and measurement decisions, and the ability to partner effectively with media specialists. Analytical fluency in cohort analysis and growth economics, including incrementality, LTV, CAC, payback, and contribution margin. Experience adapting and running campaigns across Latin American markets, using local audience behavior, channels, language, and cultural context to improve relevance and performance at scale. Experience owning growth goals and delivering measurable user or revenue outcomes across product and marketing levers. The ability to influence and align central and regional teams, translate local needs into scalable approaches, and make progress through ambiguity. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team Qualifications Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content Portfolio featuring published work preferred Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred Compensation Writers are paid on a per-word basis. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations | Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA (Hybrid) About the Role The Cloudflare Hyperdrive team builds the technology that makes regional databases feel like they are global. Hyperdrive is a core piece of the Cloudflare Developer Platform that accelerates database queries from Cloudflare Workers by pooling connections and caching data at the edge. By eliminating the massive latency overhead of TCP, TLS, and database-specific handshakes, Hyperdrive allows developers to use the databases they already know and love—like PostgreSQL and MySQL—without the "cold start" performance penalties typically associated with serverless environments. Responsibilities Hyperdrive is integrated directly into the Cloudflare global network and features: Global Connection Pooling: Maintains "warm" connections to origin databases across the globe, reducing connection times by up to 90%. Intelligent Query Caching: Automatically caches frequently run read queries as close to the user as possible. Protocol-Aware Proxying: Features custom-built implementations of database wire protocols (PostgreSQL and MySQL) to parse and optimize traffic in real-time. Seamless Integration: Works with existing ORMs and drivers, providing a simple connection string that "just works" for developers. The team is geographically distributed across North America. You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. On any given day, you might write a design document that outlines how you plan to solve a specific problem, or fix a bug in how our user experience renders. You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies including, but not limited to Rust, Go, C++, Typescript. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience You have 5+ years of professional experience with Rust, Go, or C++. You understand how to write code that respects CPU and memory constraints. You are comfortable with the Linux networking stack. You know your way around TCP/IP, TLS, and WebSockets. You don’t just use databases; you understand how they work. You’re familiar with connection lifecycles, transaction states, and wire protocols. You enjoy the challenge of debugging complex, distributed systems and building for "five nines" reliability. Bonus Points Experience with PgBouncer, ProxySQL, or custom database middleware. Familiarity with the Cloudflare Workers ecosystem and the unique stateful connection challenges of ephemeral computing. You’ve contributed to database drivers, ORMs, or low-level networking libraries. Experience using eBPF, perf, or other profiling tools to find and kill bottlenecks. Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. F or Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000 For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000 Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. Benefits Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S. Health & Welfare Benefits Medical/Rx Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Flexible Spending Accounts Commuter Spending Accounts Fertility & Family Forming Benefits On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program Global Travel Medical Insurance Financial Benefits Short and Long Term Disability Insurance Life & Accident Insurance 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan Employee Stock Participation Plan Time Off Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. descriptionAr: Role Overview In this Strategy and Operations, Customer Success role, you will drive the strategy, processes, and data-driven insights that empower our Customer Success Team to deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers. Reporting to the Manager of Strategy and Operations, and partnering closely with Customer Success leadership, you will define strategies and execute improvements that optimize customer health, retention, and revenue growth. Our Customer Success team is consistently praised by our customers for their deep expertise, responsiveness, and dedication—a testament to how much we Care Deeply About Customers, one of our core Operating Principles. As we continue to scale, it’s critical that we preserve and enhance this high standard of customer care while ensuring our processes, tools, and insights evolve to support sustainable growth. You will play a crucial role in our operations, including process improvements, planning, and reporting. This is both a strategic and tactical role in which you’ll design frameworks and programs, uncover actionable insights, and create data-informed recommendations across our Customer Success functions. What you'll do at Ashby: Operationalize CS Strategy: Develop and refine processes, tools, and workflows to scale Customer Success operations. This includes customer segmentation, onboarding workflows, lifecycle mapping, and playbook development. Analyze Business Dynamics: Partner with internal stakeholders on reporting & analysis of metrics such as NRR, GRR, churn, product adoption, health score, and customer sentiment. Use these insights to provide early warnings and refine CS strategies. Optimizate the Customer Journey: Enhance the end-to-end customer journey, ensuring smooth transitions across all post-sales touch points from onboarding through support and renewal. Support Strategic Planning: Collaborate with Finance and CS leadership on planning cycles, including headcount planning, capacity modeling, and quota setting. Provide relevant historical data for informed decision making. Drive Process Improvements: Identify inefficiencies and implement improvements to CS workflows, customer onboarding, account transitions, and renewal processes. Implement & deploy KPIs to measure performance against strategic initiatives. Optimize CS Systems: Define the business requirements to improve Customer Success efficiency, efficacy, and scalability. Partner with RevOps teammates to implement changes to tools (CRM, health scoring platforms, etc) Collaborate Cross-functionally : Ensure alignment with Sales, Product, and other teams to align resources with customer needs and forecasted growth. Support Change Management: Lead the roll-out and adoption of new processes or workflows to the CS team. Partner with Enablement on larger scale change programs. You could be a great fit if you: Are a self-starter, innately curious in your approach Bring both SaaS & financial literacy, offering an informed perspective on CS benchmarks (e.g.ideal book sizes) Have a strategic mindset, with the ability to distill data into actionable recommendations Are detail-oriented and committed to data accuracy and process quality Have experience in fast-growth SaaS environments, ideally in a Customer Success or Revenue Operations role Are skilled in CRM reporting, with preference for HubSpot experience Work autonomously, managing multiple tasks and deadlines effectively Are an excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing This role may not be a fit if: You’re unwilling to manage both high-level strategy and hands-on execution You’re uncomfortable with ambiguity and prefer structured, predefined assignments You prefer focused work on a single project at a time You prefer working within a single team rather than across multiple teams Interview Process Our interview process is thorough — we aim to ensure each person joining the team is the right fit for Ashby and will provide ample information to assess if Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is as follows: Recruiter Screen with Talent Acquisition Team - 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview - 45 minutes Challenge Interview - 45 minutes Virtual Onsite - 90 min Benefits 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable. Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅. Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise. Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive! $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval. If you’re in the US, top-notch health insurance for you and your dependents, with all premiums covered by us. Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.
